Applicants who don't ask questions at the end of an interview most probably ruin their chance of
The interviewee should test their phone connection before they call the interviewer.
It is annoying to the interviewer to find the applicant doing other tasks while being interviewed.
To pass a phone interview, the most important thing is to answer questions clearly and concisely.
If you fail to call the interviewer on time, they might not see you as a suitable candidate.
Applicants should avoid talking about their personal lives if the interviewer has only asked about
It is impolite for an interviewee to interrupt the interviewer in the phone conversation.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级（模拟节选）
items.prompt: 中国的移动支付近年来发展迅速。如今，无论是在城市还是乡村，人们只需用手机扫一扫二维码，就可以购买商品、乘坐公交，甚至缴纳水电费。移动支付不仅节省了时间，还减少了人们对现金的依赖。许多外国游客对此感到惊讶，认为这是中国日常生活中最方便的发明之一。
items.reference: Mobile payment has developed rapidly in China in recent years. Today, whether in cities or in the countryside, people can simply scan a QR code with their mobile phones to buy goods, take a bus, or even pay their water and electricity bills. Mobile payment not only saves time but also reduces people's reliance on cash. Many foreign visitors are surprised by it and regard it as one of the most convenient inventions in daily life in China.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 01
items.prompt: 中国是茶的故乡，饮茶的历史已有数千年。茶不仅是一种饮品，也是一种生活方式。客人来访时，主人通常会先奉上一杯热茶，以表示欢迎与尊重。不同地区的人们喜爱不同的茶：南方人偏爱绿茶，北方人则更常喝花茶。近年来，越来越多的年轻人开始学习茶艺，茶馆也成了朋友聚会的好去处。茶文化强调平静与分享，这或许正是它在快节奏的现代生活中依然受欢迎的原因。
items.reference: China is the home of tea, and the history of tea drinking there goes back thousands of years. Tea is not only a drink but also a way of life. When guests visit, the host usually offers them a cup of hot tea first as a sign of welcome and respect. People in different regions prefer different kinds of tea: those in the south favour green tea, while those in the north more often drink scented tea. In recent years, more and more young people have begun to learn the art of tea making, and tea houses have become popular places for friends to meet. Tea culture stresses calmness and sharing, which may explain why it is still welcome in the fast pace of modern life.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 02
items.prompt: 中国高铁的发展速度令世界瞩目。如今，高铁网络连接了全国大多数大中城市，从北京到上海只需四个多小时。高铁不仅缩短了城市之间的时间距离，也改变了人们的生活方式：有人乘高铁上下班，有人周末去另一座城市看展览。与飞机相比，高铁车站通常离市区更近，乘车手续也更简便。许多外国游客把乘坐中国高铁列为旅行中难忘的体验。高铁还带动了沿线小城市的发展，使人才和资源流动更加便利。
items.reference: The development of China's high-speed railway has attracted worldwide attention. Today the network connects most large and medium-sized cities in the country, and the journey from Beijing to Shanghai takes only a little over four hours. High-speed trains have not only shortened the travel time between cities but also changed the way people live: some people commute by high-speed train, and others travel to another city for an exhibition at the weekend. Compared with planes, high-speed railway stations are usually closer to city centres and the boarding procedures are simpler. Many foreign visitors regard a ride on a Chinese high-speed train as an unforgettable experience of their trip. The railways have also boosted the development of smaller cities along the lines, making it easier for talent and resources to flow.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 03
items.prompt: “绿水青山就是金山银山”这一理念如今被越来越多的中国人所熟悉。它提醒我们，保护环境与发展经济并不矛盾。近年来，许多地方通过植树造林、治理河流和建设公园，让曾经污染的矿区变成了旅游景点。当地居民靠经营民宿和出售农产品增加了收入，也更加珍惜身边的环境。绿色发展意味着节约资源、减少浪费，把干净的空气和水留给下一代。这不仅是政府的责任，也需要每个人从日常生活做起。
items.reference: The idea that green mountains and clear waters are as valuable as gold and silver is now familiar to more and more Chinese people. It reminds us that protecting the environment and developing the economy do not contradict each other. In recent years, many places have turned polluted mining areas into tourist attractions by planting trees, cleaning up rivers and building parks. Local residents have earned more by running guesthouses and selling farm products, and they value the environment around them even more. Green development means saving resources, reducing waste and leaving clean air and water to the next generation. This is not only the responsibility of the government; it also requires each of us to start with our daily lives.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 04
items.prompt: 敦煌莫高窟位于中国西北的沙漠之中，是世界上规模最大的佛教艺术宝库之一。自公元四世纪起，人们在洞窟中绘制壁画、塑造佛像，历经千余年，留下了大量珍贵的艺术品。这些洞窟不仅记录了佛教在中国的传播，也反映了古代丝绸之路上的商贸往来与文化交流。近年来，研究人员利用数字技术对壁画进行高精度拍摄，建立了完整的图像档案，使这些脆弱的艺术珍品得以长久保存，也让世界各地的人们可以在线欣赏它们的美丽。
items.reference: The Mogao Caves in Dunhuang, located in the desert of northwest China, are one of the largest treasure houses of Buddhist art in the world. Since the fourth century, people have painted murals and made statues of Buddha in these caves. Over more than a thousand years they left behind a great number of precious works of art. The caves not only record how Buddhism spread in China but also reflect the trade and cultural exchanges along the ancient Silk Road. In recent years, researchers have used digital technology to photograph the murals at high resolution and have built a complete image archive. As a result, these fragile treasures can be preserved for a long time, and people all over the world can enjoy their beauty online.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 05
items.prompt: 春节是中国最重要的传统节日。每到农历新年，人们会提前几周打扫房屋、贴春联、准备丰盛的年夜饭。除夕之夜，全家人尽量聚在一起吃团圆饭，长辈还会给孩子压岁钱。许多地方还保留着放鞭炮、舞龙舞狮的习俗，寓意辞旧迎新、祈求来年吉祥。如今，虽然城市里对燃放烟花有严格限制，但人们通过视频通话、电子红包等方式，同样传递着对亲友的祝福和对新年的期盼。
items.reference: The Spring Festival is the most important traditional festival in China. As the lunar new year approaches, people clean their houses, put up spring couplets and prepare a rich dinner several weeks in advance. On New Year's Eve, the whole family tries to get together for a reunion meal, and elders give children lucky money. In many places the old customs of setting off firecrackers and performing dragon and lion dances are still kept, which means saying goodbye to the old year and praying for good luck in the coming one. Today, although setting off fireworks is strictly limited in cities, people still send their good wishes and hopes for the new year to relatives and friends through video calls and electronic red envelopes.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 06
items.prompt: 丝绸之路是古代连接中国与中亚、欧洲的重要商路。两千多年前，商人们沿着这条道路，把中国的丝绸、茶叶和瓷器运往西方，也把葡萄、香料和音乐带回中国。丝绸之路不仅是一条贸易通道，更是一条文化交流之路。沿着它，佛教传入中国，中国的造纸术也传向世界。今天，这条古老的商路依然吸引着无数旅行者和学者，人们希望从中了解不同文明如何相互学习、共同发展。
items.reference: The Silk Road was an important trade route linking China with Central Asia and Europe in ancient times. More than two thousand years ago, traders carried Chinese silk, tea and porcelain to the West along this road, and brought grapes, spices and music back to China. The Silk Road was not only a trade route but also a road of cultural exchange. Along it, Buddhism spread into China, and Chinese paper-making techniques travelled to the rest of the world. Today this ancient route still attracts countless travellers and scholars, who hope to learn from it how different civilizations can learn from one another and develop together.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 07
items.prompt: 中国的移动支付已经成为日常生活中很普通的一部分。无论是在超市结账，还是在路边买一份早点，人们只要拿出手机扫一下二维码，几秒钟就能完成付款。这种方式不仅省去了排队找零的麻烦，也让许多小摊主不必准备大量现金。对游客来说，移动支付同样方便，他们可以在手机上绑定银行卡，用一部手机完成旅行中的大部分消费。不过，也有老人表示，自己不太会使用这些软件，希望商家仍然保留现金支付的选项。
items.reference: Mobile payment has become an ordinary part of daily life in China. Whether paying at a supermarket checkout or buying breakfast at a roadside stall, people only need to take out their phones and scan a QR code, and the payment is completed within seconds. This method not only saves the trouble of queuing and making change, but also means that many small stallholders no longer need to keep large amounts of cash. For visitors, mobile payment is convenient as well: they can link a bank card to their phone and use a single device for most of their spending during a trip. Some elderly people, however, say that they are not good at using these apps and hope that shops will still keep the option of paying in cash.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 08
items.prompt: 中医是中国传统医学的重要组成部分，它强调人体与自然环境的平衡。中医认为，人的健康取决于饮食、情绪、作息等因素是否协调，因此提出了许多日常养生的方法。例如，在寒冷的季节多吃温热的食物，在夏天注意补充水分；保持规律的作息，避免过度劳累。近年来，越来越多的年轻人开始关注中医养生，学习按摩和药膳。不过，专家提醒，养生方法应当根据个人体质选择，不能盲目照搬。
items.reference: Traditional Chinese medicine is an important part of China's traditional medical culture, and it stresses the balance between the human body and the natural environment. In its view, a person's health depends on whether diet, emotions and daily routines are in harmony, so many methods of everyday health care have been developed. For example, people are advised to eat warm food in cold seasons and to drink enough water in summer, and to keep regular hours and avoid overwork. In recent years, more and more young people have become interested in traditional health care and have started learning massage and medicinal dishes. Experts remind them, however, that such methods should be chosen according to individual constitution rather than copied blindly.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 09
items.prompt: 近年来，中国许多城市修建了绿道，把公园、河流和居民区连接起来。绿道两旁种满树木，设有步道和自行车道，市民可以在那里散步、跑步或骑行。这些绿色空间不仅改善了城市环境，也为邻里交往提供了场所。周末，常能看到父母带着孩子骑车，老人在树荫下聊天。专家认为，城市在建设绿道时，应当考虑不同人群的需要，并做好日常维护，让这些空间真正融入居民的生活。
items.reference: In recent years, many Chinese cities have built greenways that connect parks, rivers and residential areas. The greenways are lined with trees and provided with footpaths and cycle lanes, where citizens can walk, run or ride. These green spaces not only improve the urban environment but also offer places for neighbours to meet. At weekends, it is common to see parents cycling with their children and elderly people chatting in the shade of the trees. Experts believe that when building greenways, cities should take the needs of different groups into account and carry out regular maintenance, so that these spaces truly become part of residents' lives.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 大学英语四级标准模拟卷 10
items.prompt: 数字经济正成为中国经济增长的重要动力。随着5G网络的普及，人们可以在几秒钟内下载一部电影，偏远地区的病人也能通过视频接受城市医生的诊断。在工厂里，5G技术让机器之间的配合更加精确，生产效率明显提高。专家认为，数字技术不仅创造了新的产业，也改变了普通人的生活方式。未来，如何让更多人分享数字红利，将是一项重要的社会课题。
items.reference: The digital economy is becoming an important driver of China's economic growth. With the spread of 5G networks, people can download a film within seconds, and patients in remote areas can be diagnosed by city doctors through video calls. In factories, 5G technology allows machines to work together more precisely, and production efficiency has improved markedly. Experts believe that digital technology has not only created new industries but also changed the way ordinary people live. In the future, how to let more people share the benefits of the digital economy will be an important social question.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
items.prompt: 元旦前夕，学校礼堂里举行了一场联欢晚会。师生们自己编排节目，有合唱、舞蹈，也有小品和乐器演奏。晚会开始时，校长发表了简短的新年致辞，随后屏幕上播放了一年来校园生活的照片。最受欢迎的环节是抽奖，幸运的同学得到了书和文具。午夜钟声敲响时，全场一起倒数，互相祝福新年快乐。这样的晚会不仅让大家放松，也让师生之间的关系更加亲近。
items.reference: On New Year's Eve, a gala was held in the school hall. Teachers and students put on the performances themselves, including a chorus, dances, short plays and instrumental music. At the beginning of the gala, the headmaster gave a short New Year speech, and then photos of campus life over the past year were shown on the screen. The most popular part was the lucky draw, in which lucky students received books and stationery. When the clock struck midnight, everyone counted down together and wished each other a happy New Year. Such a gala not only helps people relax but also brings teachers and students closer to each other.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
items.prompt: 农历是中国传统的历法，已有几千年的历史。它根据月亮的变化来划分月份，同时通过设置闰月来适应四季的更替。对中国农民来说，农历指导着播种和收获；对普通人来说，春节、端午节和中秋节等传统节日都按照农历计算。即使在今天，许多家庭仍然会在农历生日那天吃长寿面，也会在春节前贴上红色的春联。农历不仅是一种记时的方法，也承载着中国人的文化记忆。
items.reference: The lunar calendar is a traditional Chinese calendar with a history of several thousand years. It divides the months according to the changes of the moon, and at the same time adjusts to the change of the four seasons by adding leap months. For Chinese farmers, the lunar calendar guides sowing and harvesting; for ordinary people, traditional festivals such as the Spring Festival, the Dragon Boat Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival are all calculated according to the lunar calendar. Even today, many families still eat long noodles on their lunar birthdays and put up red couplets before the Spring Festival. The lunar calendar is not only a way of keeping time but also carries the cultural memory of the Chinese people.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
items.prompt: 近年来，中国新能源汽车产业发展迅速。越来越多的人选择购买电动汽车，既因为充电比加油便宜，也因为人们更加关注空气质量和环境保护。在城市里，充电桩已经出现在停车场、商场和居民小区中。中国企业还在电池技术和智能驾驶方面不断取得突破，一些品牌的汽车已经出口到许多国家。不过，行业也面临充电设施分布不均、电池回收等问题。专家认为，只有持续创新并完善相关服务，新能源汽车才能走进更多家庭。
items.reference: In recent years, China's new energy vehicle industry has developed rapidly. More and more people choose to buy electric cars, partly because charging is cheaper than buying petrol, and partly because they pay greater attention to air quality and environmental protection. In cities, charging piles have appeared in car parks, shopping malls and residential communities. Chinese companies have also kept making breakthroughs in battery technology and intelligent driving, and cars from some brands have already been exported to many countries. However, the industry still faces problems such as the uneven distribution of charging facilities and the recycling of used batteries. Experts believe that only by continuing to innovate and improving related services can new energy vehicles truly reach more families.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
items.prompt: 中国园林有着悠久的历史，是中华文化的重要组成部分。与中国北方的皇家园林不同，江南的私家园林往往面积不大，却通过假山、水池、花木和曲折的回廊营造出变化丰富的空间。设计者讲究「借景」和「步移景异」，让游人在有限的地方感受到自然的意趣。园林中的亭台楼阁不仅是休息之处，也常被用来读书、作画和会友。今天，许多古典园林已成为著名的旅游景点，吸引着世界各地的游客。保护这些园林，就是保护一种独特的生活方式和审美传统。
items.reference: Chinese gardens have a long history and form an important part of Chinese culture. Unlike the royal gardens of northern China, private gardens in the region south of the Yangtze are often small in size, yet they create a rich variety of space through rockeries, ponds, flowers and trees, and winding corridors. Their designers paid great attention to borrowing views from the surroundings and to making the scenery change with every step, so that visitors can feel the charm of nature within a limited area. The pavilions and towers in these gardens were not only places to rest, but also places to read, paint and meet friends. Today many classical gardens have become famous tourist attractions that draw visitors from all over the world. To protect them is to protect a distinctive way of life and a tradition of beauty.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
items.prompt: 近年来，城市漫步在年轻人中越来越受欢迎。与赶路式的旅游不同，它强调放慢脚步，随意走进老街区、小巷和公园，感受城市的历史与日常生活。一些城市还设计了主题漫步路线。有人认为这只是社交网络上的风潮，但它确实让人们重新认识了身边的城市，也让一些老街区获得新的活力。专家建议，城市漫步应尊重居民生活，不要打扰社区安宁。
items.reference: In recent years, city walking has become increasingly popular among young people. Unlike travel that is all about rushing from one sight to another, it encourages people to slow down, wander into old neighbourhoods, narrow lanes and parks, and feel the history and daily life of a city as they walk. Some cities have designed themed walking routes. Some people regard this as a passing fashion on social media, but it has indeed helped people rediscover the city around them and has brought new energy to neglected old streets. Experts suggest that city walkers should respect residents' lives and not disturb the peace of local communities.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题风格卷（原创题面）
items.prompt:
Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to translate the following Chinese passage into English. The passage is about table manners in China.

在中国人的餐桌上，礼仪往往体现在细节里。长辈先动筷，客人坐在主人的右侧或上座；夹菜时要用公筷，不要把筷子插在饭里。主人会不断为客人添菜，这既是热情，也是一种含蓄的关心。客人不必把饭菜全部吃完，但应当尝一尝主人推荐的菜。用餐结束时，主人通常会把客人送到门口，说一句慢走。这些看似简单的习惯，体现了中国人重视长幼、尊重客人的传统。
items.reference: At a Chinese dinner table, good manners are often shown in small details. The elders start eating first, and guests are seated on the host's right or in the seat of honour. When taking food, people use serving chopsticks, and they never stand their chopsticks upright in a bowl of rice. The host keeps adding dishes to the guests' plates; this is both generosity and a quiet way of showing care. Guests do not have to finish everything, but they should taste the dishes the host recommends. At the end of the meal, the host usually walks the guests to the door and asks them to take care on their way home. These simple habits reflect a tradition in which age and respect for guests matter.

items.title: Translation 翻译
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语六级（模拟节选）
items.prompt: 近年来，中国的博物馆数量迅速增长，越来越多的年轻人把参观博物馆当作一种休闲方式。许多博物馆借助数字技术，把珍贵文物以虚拟现实的形式呈现，使观众能够近距离欣赏那些平时无法接触的展品。与此同时，博物馆还通过社交媒体与公众互动，推出丰富多彩的教育活动。专家认为，博物馆不仅是保存历史的场所，也是连接过去与未来的桥梁。
items.reference: In recent years, the number of museums in China has grown rapidly, and more and more young people regard visiting museums as a way of spending their leisure time. Many museums use digital technology to present precious cultural relics in virtual reality, enabling visitors to appreciate at close range exhibits that are normally inaccessible. Meanwhile, museums interact with the public through social media and offer a variety of educational activities. Experts believe that museums are not only places where history is preserved but also bridges connecting the past and the future.

items.title: 2023年12月六级翻译：中国人口老龄化应对
items.paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语六级第一套
items.prompt: 随着经济与社会的发展，中国人口结构发生了显著变化，逐渐步入老龄化社会。中国老年人口将持续增加，人口老龄化趋势将更加明显。为了应对人口老龄化带来的种种挑战，国家正积极采取措施，加大对养老的支持。通过改革社会保障（social security）制度，政府不断增加社会保障经费，逐步扩大社会保障覆盖范围，使更多老年人受益。政府还鼓励各种社会团体为老年人提供服务。在政府和社会团体的共同努力下，老年人将生活得更加幸福。
items.reference: With the development of the economy and society, China's population structure has undergone significant changes, gradually entering an aging society. China's elderly population will continue to increase, and the trend of population aging will become more pronounced. In order to cope with the various challenges brought by population aging, the country is actively taking measures to increase support for elderly care. By reforming the social security system, the government has continuously increased social security funding and gradually expanded the coverage of social security, benefiting more elderly people. The government also encourages various social organizations to provide services for the elderly. With the joint efforts of the government and social organizations, the elderly will live happier lives.
keyPoints: 人口老龄化 → population aging
老龄化社会 → aging society
社会保障 → social security
养老 → elderly care
社会团体 → social organizations
覆盖范围 → coverage

items.title: 2023年12月六级翻译：养老模式多元化
items.paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语六级第二套
items.prompt: 在中国，随着老龄化社会的到来，养老受到普遍关注。人们谈论最多的是应当采取什么样的养老模式。多数人认为，养老模式需要多元化。可以通过政府引导和社会参与，建立更多更好的养老服务机构，改进社区服务中心，鼓励居家自助养老，还可以推行家庭养老与社会养老相结合的模式。随着政府和社会对养老服务事业投入的持续增加，养老设施将不断升级，服务质量逐步改进，老年人的生活将会更加方便舒适、健康快乐。
items.reference: In China, with the arrival of an aging society, elderly care has attracted widespread attention. What people discuss most is what kind of elderly care model should be adopted. Most people believe that elderly care models need to be diversified. Through government guidance and social participation, more and better elderly care service institutions can be established, community service centers can be improved, home-based self-care for the elderly can be encouraged, and a model combining family care with social care can be promoted. As the government and society continue to increase investment in elderly care services, elderly care facilities will be continuously upgraded, service quality will gradually improve, and the lives of the elderly will become more convenient, comfortable, healthy, and happy.
keyPoints: 养老模式 → elderly care model
多元化 → diversified
养老服务机构 → elderly care service institutions
居家养老 → home-based elderly care
家庭养老 → family care
社会养老 → social care

items.title: 2023年12月六级翻译：养老服务体系建设
items.paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语六级第三套
items.prompt: 近年来，中国老龄人口持续增长。中国政府正采取各种措施，推进养老服务体系建设，使老年人晚年生活健康幸福。全国兴建了各类养老服务机构。为了提升养老机构的服务质量，政府颁布了一系列标准，加强对养老机构的监管。许多城市为方便老年人用餐，开设了社区食堂，为他们提供价格实惠的饭菜。行动不便的老年人还能享受上门送餐服务。同时，中国还在积极探索居家和社区养老等其他养老模式，以确保所有老年人老有所养。
items.reference: In recent years, China's elderly population has continued to grow. The Chinese government is taking various measures to advance the construction of an elderly care service system, enabling the elderly to live healthy and happy lives in their later years. Various types of elderly care service institutions have been established across the country. To improve the service quality of elderly care institutions, the government has promulgated a series of standards and strengthened supervision of elderly care institutions. Many cities have opened community canteens to make it convenient for the elderly to have meals, providing them with affordable food. Elderly people with mobility difficulties can also enjoy meal delivery services. At the same time, China is actively exploring other elderly care models such as home-based and community-based care to ensure that all elderly people are well cared for.
keyPoints: 养老服务体系 → elderly care service system
养老机构 → elderly care institutions
监管 → supervision
社区食堂 → community canteens
上门送餐 → meal delivery services
老有所养 → well cared for

items.title: 2023年6月六级翻译：城市公共设施建设
items.paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语六级第一套
items.prompt: 随着中国经济的快速发展和人们生活水平的稳步提高，城市居民对环境和生活品质的要求越来越高。中国地方政府更加注重公共设施的建设和改进，以更好地满足人们的需求。通过兴建新的广场、公园和公共绿地或对原有公共场地重新加以规划改造，许多城市为市民提供了更多休闲和社交的场所。如今，政府出资购置的健身器械和铺设的健身步道在不少城市随处可见，既明显改善了市民户外活动的条件，又使城市更加美丽。
items.reference: With the rapid development of China's economy and the steady improvement of people's living standards, urban residents have increasingly higher requirements for the environment and quality of life. Local governments in China are paying more attention to the construction and improvement of public facilities to better meet people's needs. By building new squares, parks, and public green spaces, or by re-planning and renovating existing public spaces, many cities have provided citizens with more places for leisure and social activities. Today, fitness equipment purchased by the government and fitness trails laid by the government can be seen everywhere in many cities, which has not only significantly improved the conditions for citizens' outdoor activities, but also made cities more beautiful.
keyPoints: 生活水平 → living standards
公共设施 → public facilities
公共绿地 → public green spaces
休闲和社交 → leisure and social activities
健身器械 → fitness equipment
健身步道 → fitness trails

items.title: 2023年6月六级翻译：中国文化产品走向世界
items.paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语六级第二套
items.prompt: 近年来，越来越多的中国文化产品走向全球市场，日益受到海外消费者的青睐。随着中国对外文化贸易的快速发展，中国文化产品出口额已持续多年位居世界前列，形成了一批具有国际影响力的文化企业、产品和品牌。数据显示，中国的出版物、影视作品、网络文学与动漫作品等在海外的销售量连年攀升。中国政府出台了一系列政策鼓励和支持更多具有中国元素的优秀文化产品走出国门，扩大海外市场份额，进一步提升中国文化的世界影响力。
items.reference: In recent years, more and more Chinese cultural products have entered the global market and are increasingly favored by overseas consumers. With the rapid development of China's foreign cultural trade, China's cultural product exports have ranked among the top in the world for many consecutive years, forming a group of cultural enterprises, products, and brands with international influence. Data shows that the overseas sales of China's publications, film and television works, online literature, and animation works have been rising year after year. The Chinese government has introduced a series of policies to encourage and support more excellent cultural products with Chinese elements to go global, expand overseas market share, and further enhance the global influence of Chinese culture.
keyPoints: 文化产品 → cultural products
对外文化贸易 → foreign cultural trade
国际影响力 → international influence
影视作品 → film and television works
网络文学 → online literature
海外市场份额 → overseas market share

items.title: 2023年6月六级翻译：城市高质量发展
items.paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语六级第三套
items.prompt: 近年来，中国城市加快发展，城市人居环境得到显著改善。许多城市努力探索中国特色的城市高质量发展之路，城市功能不断完善，治理水平明显提高。中国持续开展城市生态修复和功能修补，全面实施城镇老旧小区改造，大力推进城市园林绿化，消除污染；同时大力推进城市基础设施体系化建设，开展房屋建筑和市政设施普查以及安全隐患排查整治，努力为市民创造高品质的生活环境，让城市更美丽、更安全、更宜居。
items.reference: In recent years, China's cities have accelerated their development, and the urban living environment has been significantly improved. Many cities are striving to explore a path of high-quality urban development with Chinese characteristics, with urban functions continuously improving and governance levels significantly enhanced. China has continuously carried out urban ecological restoration and functional repair, comprehensively implemented the renovation of old urban residential areas, vigorously promoted urban landscaping and greening, and eliminated pollution. At the same time, it has vigorously promoted the systematic construction of urban infrastructure, conducted surveys of buildings and municipal facilities, and investigated and rectified potential safety hazards, striving to create a high-quality living environment for citizens and make cities more beautiful, safer, and more livable.
keyPoints: 人居环境 → living environment
高质量发展 → high-quality development
生态修复 → ecological restoration
老旧小区改造 → renovation of old residential areas
园林绿化 → landscaping and greening
宜居 → livable

items.title: 2024年12月六级翻译：北斗卫星导航系统
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语六级第一套
items.prompt: 北斗（Beidou）卫星导航系统的成功研制是中国自改革开放以来取得的一项重大科技成就。研发人员经过不懈努力，攻克了一系列技术难题，北斗系统最终实现了全球覆盖和高精度定位，使中国成为世界上少数几个独立拥有全球卫星导航系统的国家之一。北斗系统已广泛应用于交通运输、灾害救援、天气预报、公共安全等诸多领域。北斗系统现在已经在国际上得到广泛认可，开始为越来越多的国家和地区提供优质服务。
items.reference: The successful development of the Beidou Satellite Navigation System is a major scientific and technological achievement China has made since the reform and opening up. After tireless efforts, researchers overcame a series of technical difficulties, and the Beidou system ultimately achieved global coverage and high-precision positioning, making China one of the few countries in the world to independently possess a global satellite navigation system. The Beidou system has been widely applied in many fields such as transportation, disaster relief, weather forecasting, and public safety. The Beidou system has now gained wide international recognition and has begun to provide quality services to an increasing number of countries and regions.
keyPoints: 卫星导航系统 → Satellite Navigation System
高精度定位 → high-precision positioning
交通运输 → transportation
灾害救援 → disaster relief
天气预报 → weather forecasting
国际认可 → international recognition

items.title: 2024年12月六级翻译：洋山港
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语六级第二套
items.prompt: 洋山港（Yangshan Port）是上海航运中心的重要组成部分，是中国第一个深水港，也是世界上规模最大的深水港之一。经过近20年的发展，洋山港已实现高度自动化。数字技术和人工智能的使用大大减少了用工成本和碳排放。自主研发的码头管理系统可以在百公里之外对大型设备进行远程操控。洋山港看上去一片繁忙，现场却见不到人工操作，而且能够24小时不间断运作。洋山港将不断发展，为把上海建成一个全球航运中心做出更大贡献。
items.reference: Yangshan Port is an important component of Shanghai's shipping center, China's first deep-water port, and one of the largest deep-water ports in the world. After nearly 20 years of development, Yangshan Port has achieved a high degree of automation. The use of digital technology and artificial intelligence has greatly reduced labor costs and carbon emissions. The independently developed terminal management system can remotely control large equipment from hundreds of kilometers away. Yangshan Port appears to be bustling with activity, yet no manual operations can be seen on site, and it can operate continuously 24 hours a day. Yangshan Port will continue to develop and make greater contributions to building Shanghai into a global shipping center.
keyPoints: 深水港 → deep-water port
高度自动化 → high degree of automation
碳排放 → carbon emissions
码头管理系统 → terminal management system
远程操控 → remote control
全球航运中心 → global shipping center

items.title: 2024年12月六级翻译：中国航天梦
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语六级第三套
items.prompt: 遨游太空历来是中华民族的梦想。2003年，神舟五号飞船发射成功，杨利伟成为第一个飞入太空的中国宇航员。2008年，神舟七号升空，翟志刚成为中国历史上首位进行太空行走的宇航员。近年来，中国航天进入创新发展"快车道"，太空基础设施建设稳步推进，中国空间站于2022年全面建成。中国航天事业的迅速发展在中华民族的历史上写下了辉煌一页，也为人类文明进步做出了巨大贡献。未来，中国探索太空的脚步将迈得更稳、更远。
items.reference: Traveling in space has always been the dream of the Chinese nation. In 2003, the Shenzhou-5 spacecraft was successfully launched, and Yang Liwei became the first Chinese astronaut to fly into space. In 2008, Shenzhou-7 was launched, and Zhai Zhigang became the first astronaut in Chinese history to conduct a spacewalk. In recent years, China's space program has entered a "fast lane" of innovative development, with the construction of space infrastructure steadily advancing, and China's space station was fully completed in 2022. The rapid development of China's space program has written a glorious page in the history of the Chinese nation and has also made tremendous contributions to the progress of human civilization. In the future, China's steps in exploring space will be more steady and far-reaching.
keyPoints: 宇航员 → astronaut
太空行走 → spacewalk
空间站 → space station
太空基础设施 → space infrastructure
人类文明进步 → progress of human civilization
探索太空 → exploring space

items.title: 2024年6月六级翻译：中国传统婚礼
items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语六级第一套
items.prompt: 中国的传统婚礼习俗历史悠久，从周朝开始就逐渐形成了一套完整的婚礼仪式，有些一直沿用至今。如今的中式婚礼习俗已有很大变化，但婚礼庆典仍然十分隆重。婚礼场地经过精心装饰，以象征喜庆（jubilance）的红色为主色调，摆放着许多祝愿新人幸福的物件。在婚礼上，新人要拜天地（bow to Heaven and Earth），感谢父母的养育之恩，并向宾客敬茶。婚礼上的每一个环节都寄托着人们对新人的美好祝愿。
items.reference: Chinese traditional wedding customs have a long history. Starting from the Zhou Dynasty, a complete set of wedding ceremonies gradually formed, some of which are still in use today. Today's Chinese wedding customs have changed greatly, but wedding celebrations are still very grand. The wedding venue is carefully decorated, with red as the main color symbolizing jubilance, and many objects wishing the newlyweds happiness are displayed. At the wedding, the newlyweds bow to Heaven and Earth, express gratitude to their parents for raising them, and serve tea to the guests. Every aspect of the wedding carries people's best wishes for the newlyweds.
keyPoints: 传统婚礼 → traditional wedding
婚礼仪式 → wedding ceremonies
婚礼庆典 → wedding celebrations
拜天地 → bow to Heaven and Earth
养育之恩 → raising them
敬茶 → serve tea

items.title: 2024年6月六级翻译：中国竹文化
items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语六级第二套
items.prompt: 中国盛产竹子，是最早开发利用竹资源的国家。竹子在中国分布广泛，品种丰富。竹子实用性强，用于生产和生活的许多方面，如筷子、桌椅的制作和桥梁、房屋的建造。中国人爱竹，自古以来就有无数文人以竹为主题，创作了绚丽多彩的文学和绘画作品。竹子主干（stem）笔直，象征正直的品格。竹子具有强大的生命力和适应能力，无论环境多么恶劣，都能够顽强生存，因而寓意坚韧不拔的精神。几千年来，竹子一直被视为中华民族品格的象征。
items.reference: China is rich in bamboo and is the first country to develop and utilize bamboo resources. Bamboo is widely distributed in China with abundant varieties. Bamboo is highly practical and is used in many aspects of production and daily life, such as making chopsticks, tables and chairs, and constructing bridges and houses. Chinese people love bamboo, and since ancient times, countless literati have created colorful literary and artistic works with bamboo as their theme. The stem of bamboo is straight, symbolizing an upright character. Bamboo has strong vitality and adaptability, and can survive tenaciously no matter how harsh the environment, thus symbolizing an indomitable spirit. For thousands of years, bamboo has been regarded as a symbol of the Chinese national character.
keyPoints: 竹资源 → bamboo resources
实用性 → practicality
文人 → literati
正直的品格 → upright character
坚韧不拔 → indomitable spirit
民族品格 → national character

items.title: 2024年6月六级翻译：中国扇文化
items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语六级第三套
items.prompt: 扇子自古以来就深受中国人喜爱，但现在已不只是消暑纳凉的工具，而更多地作为艺术品供人欣赏。许多扇子造型优美、做工精良，并绘有山水、花鸟、人物等精美图案，具有很高的艺术价值。中国许多著名画家和书法家喜欢在扇子上作诗绘画，展示其艺术品味。扇子常作为礼物赠予他人，表达美好的祝福和真挚的情感。如今，扇子的实用功能已大为减弱，但作为一种文化符号和艺术形式，扇子仍然在中国传统文化中扮演着重要角色。
items.reference: Fans have been deeply loved by Chinese people since ancient times, but now they are no longer just tools for cooling off in summer, but are more often appreciated as works of art. Many fans have beautiful shapes, exquisite craftsmanship, and are painted with delicate patterns of landscapes, flowers and birds, and figures, possessing high artistic value. Many famous Chinese painters and calligraphers like to compose poems and paint on fans to showcase their artistic taste. Fans are often given as gifts to express good wishes and sincere feelings. Today, the practical function of fans has greatly diminished, but as a cultural symbol and art form, fans still play an important role in Chinese traditional culture.
keyPoints: 消暑纳凉 → cooling off in summer
艺术品 → works of art
书法家 → calligraphers
艺术品味 → artistic taste
文化符号 → cultural symbol
传统文化 → traditional culture

items.title: 2025年12月六级翻译：尊老传统
items.paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语六级第一套
items.prompt: 尊老是中华民族的传统美德，深深植根于中国人的思想和行为中，是人们普遍遵守的行为规范和社会准则。在当今的中国，这种美德得到广泛传承。社会各界积极营造敬老助老的社会氛围。为老年人提供便利服务已成为社会共识，例如社区专门开设长者食堂，公共场所配置优先座位。政府还出台了一系列政策，为老年人的权益提供有力保障。尊老是社会和谐与发展的重要基石，有助于构建更加和谐美好的社会。
items.reference: Respecting the elderly is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation, deeply rooted in the thoughts and behaviors of Chinese people, and is a code of conduct and social norm that people generally abide by. In today's China, this virtue is widely passed down. All sectors of society actively create a social atmosphere of respecting and helping the elderly. Providing convenient services for the elderly has become a social consensus, for example, communities have specially opened canteens for the elderly, and public places are equipped with priority seats. The government has also introduced a series of policies to provide strong protection for the rights and interests of the elderly. Respecting the elderly is an important cornerstone of social harmony and development, and helps build a more harmonious and beautiful society.
keyPoints: 传统美德 → traditional virtue
行为规范 → code of conduct
社会准则 → social norm
长者食堂 → canteens for the elderly
优先座位 → priority seats
社会和谐 → social harmony

items.title: 2025年12月六级翻译：自强自立精神
items.paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语六级第二套
items.prompt: 中华民族崇尚自强自立的精神，这一精神深植于中国文化之中，是民族生存与发展的重要支撑。改革开放以来，中国在自强自立的征程上，持续加大科研投入，在信息技术、人工智能、航天工程等领域不断取得新突破。5G网络覆盖全国，远程医疗发展迅速，电子支付的使用全球领先，嫦娥探月工程展现了航天领域引人注目的发展。自强自主精神成为推动国家现代化进程的强大动力，激励着中国人民为实现中华民族伟大复兴而不懈奋斗。
items.reference: The Chinese nation advocates the spirit of self-improvement and self-reliance, a spirit deeply rooted in Chinese culture and an important support for the nation's survival and development. Since the reform and opening up, China has continuously increased investment in scientific research on the journey of self-improvement and self-reliance, achieving new breakthroughs in fields such as information technology, artificial intelligence, and aerospace engineering. 5G networks cover the whole country, telemedicine is developing rapidly, the use of electronic payment leads the world, and the Chang'e lunar exploration project has demonstrated remarkable development in the aerospace field. The spirit of self-improvement and self-reliance has become a powerful driving force for the country's modernization process, inspiring the Chinese people to strive tirelessly for the great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation.
keyPoints: 自强自立 → self-improvement and self-reliance
科研投入 → investment in scientific research
人工智能 → artificial intelligence
航天工程 → aerospace engineering
远程医疗 → telemedicine
中华民族伟大复兴 → great rejuvenation of the Chinese nation

items.title: 2025年12月六级翻译：节俭美德
items.paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语六级第三套
items.prompt: 节俭（frugality）是中华民族的传统美德。在中国古代，生产力低下，先人们深知劳动成果来之不易，因而秉持节俭的理念。到了物质极大丰富的今天，中国人民依然坚持节俭的生活方式，体现了理性消费的生活理念和对劳动的尊重。近年来，中国政府持续加强节约型社会的建设，倡导"光盘行动"，减少食物浪费，提倡简约低碳的生活方式，推进资源循环利用，反对过度消费。节约型社会的建设有力推动了可持续发展，为子孙后代留下了宝贵的资源和良好的生态环境。
items.reference: Frugality is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation. In ancient China, with low productivity, ancestors knew well that the fruits of labor were hard-won, and thus adhered to the concept of frugality. Even today, when material wealth is greatly abundant, the Chinese people still insist on a frugal lifestyle, reflecting the concept of rational consumption and respect for labor. In recent years, the Chinese government has continuously strengthened the construction of a conservation-oriented society, advocating the "Clean Plate Campaign" to reduce food waste, promoting a simple and low-carbon lifestyle, advancing resource recycling, and opposing excessive consumption. The construction of a conservation-oriented society has powerfully promoted sustainable development, leaving precious resources and a good ecological environment for future generations.
keyPoints: 节俭 → frugality
劳动成果 → fruits of labor
理性消费 → rational consumption
光盘行动 → Clean Plate Campaign
资源循环利用 → resource recycling
可持续发展 → sustainable development

items.title: 2025年6月六级翻译：天宫空间站
items.paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语六级第一套
items.prompt: 天宫空间站（Tiangong Space Station）是中国首个太空实验室，拥有110多立方米使用空间，可驻留3名航天员，在距地球表面400—450公里的轨道上运行。天宫空间站已实施180多个科学研究与应用项目，涉及空间生命科学、太空医学、空间材料科学等领域。天宫空间站的研究成果在我国得到了广泛应用，产生了显著的经济效益。例如，太空育种创造的直接经济价值已超过2000亿元。天宫空间站将继续为人类探索宇宙、造福人类作出更大贡献。
items.reference: The Tiangong Space Station is China's first space laboratory, with more than 110 cubic meters of usable space, capable of accommodating 3 astronauts, and operating in an orbit 400 to 450 kilometers above the Earth's surface. The Tiangong Space Station has implemented more than 180 scientific research and application projects, covering fields such as space life science, space medicine, and space materials science. The research results of the Tiangong Space Station have been widely applied in China, generating significant economic benefits. For example, the direct economic value created by space breeding has exceeded 200 billion yuan. The Tiangong Space Station will continue to make greater contributions to humanity's exploration of the universe and the benefit of mankind.
keyPoints: 太空实验室 → space laboratory
航天员 → astronauts
空间生命科学 → space life science
太空医学 → space medicine
太空育种 → space breeding
探索宇宙 → exploration of the universe

items.title: 2025年6月六级翻译：南水北调工程
items.paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语六级第二套
items.prompt: 自古以来，中国的水资源北缺南丰，分布极不均衡。为了有效解决北方严重缺水问题，中国政府实施了南水北调工程（the South-to-North Water Diversion Project）。这是一项跨区域配置水资源的宏大水利工程。历经数十年的规划与筹备，工程于2002年开工建设，分为东、中、西3条线路，总长4350公里，惠及人口将超过4亿。自2014年通水以来，工程向北方调水累计已超500亿立方米，有效缓解了北方地区的水资源短缺问题，改善了沿线地区的生态环境，促进了区域经济社会的协调发展。
items.reference: Since ancient times, China's water resources have been scarce in the north and abundant in the south, with extremely uneven distribution. To effectively address the serious water shortage in the north, the Chinese government implemented the South-to-North Water Diversion Project. This is a grand water conservancy project for cross-regional allocation of water resources. After decades of planning and preparation, construction began in 2002, divided into three routes — eastern, central, and western — with a total length of 4,350 kilometers, benefiting a population of more than 400 million. Since water was first diverted in 2014, the project has transferred a cumulative total of more than 50 billion cubic meters of water to the north, effectively alleviating the water shortage in northern regions, improving the ecological environment along the routes, and promoting the coordinated development of regional economy and society.
keyPoints: 南水北调 → South-to-North Water Diversion
水资源 → water resources
水利工程 → water conservancy project
跨区域 → cross-regional
生态环境 → ecological environment
协调发展 → coordinated development

items.title: 2025年6月六级翻译：粤港澳大湾区
items.paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语六级第三套
items.prompt: 粤港澳大湾区（Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area）具有得天独厚的地理位置，拥有完善的交通基础设施和丰富的产业资源。大湾区是中国开放程度最高、经济活力最强的区域之一，在国家经济发展中具有重要的战略地位。大湾区不仅将建成充满活力的世界级城市群和具有全球影响力的国际科技创新中心，还将打造成适合工作、购物、旅游的优质生活圈。随着改革开放的不断深入，大湾区的发展将为中国乃至世界经济注入新的活力。
items.reference: The Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area has a uniquely advantageous geographical location, with well-developed transportation infrastructure and abundant industrial resources. The Greater Bay Area is one of the most open and economically dynamic regions in China, with an important strategic position in the country's economic development. The Greater Bay Area will not only be built into a vibrant world-class urban agglomeration and an international science and technology innovation center with global influence, but will also be developed into a high-quality living circle suitable for work, shopping, and tourism. As reform and opening up continues to deepen, the development of the Greater Bay Area will inject new vitality into China's and even the world's economy.
keyPoints: 粤港澳大湾区 → Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area
交通基础设施 → transportation infrastructure
经济活力 → economic vitality
城市群 → urban agglomeration
科技创新中心 → science and technology innovation center
改革开放 → reform and opening up

items.prompt: 在中国，火锅已有2,000多年的历史，最早流行于最寒冷的地区，然后在很多地区盛行，出现了具有地方特色的种类。吃火锅时，家人和朋友围坐在桌边，桌子中间放着热腾腾的火锅。吃火锅时，人们可以根据自己的口味放肉、海鲜、蔬菜和其他配料，自己烹饪。人们可以一边尽情地聊天，一边享受美食。
items.reference: In China, hot pot has a history of more than 2,000 years. It first became popular in the coldest regions and then spread to many other areas, giving rise to varieties with distinct local features. When eating hot pot, family and friends sit around a table, with a steaming hot pot in the middle. They can add meat, seafood, vegetables and other ingredients according to their own tastes, and cook them themselves. Meanwhile, they can chat to their hearts' content while enjoying the food.

items.paperTitle: 2020年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: 茅台(Moutai)是中国最有名的白酒，在新中国成立前夕，被选为国宴用酒。 据说赤水沿岸的村民四千年前就开始酿造茅台。在西汉时期，那里的人们生产出了高质量的茅台，并把它贡给皇帝。自唐朝开始，这种地方酒通过海上丝绸之路运往海外。 茅台味道柔和，有一种特殊的香味；适量饮用可以帮助缓解疲劳，有镇静作用，因而广受国内外消费者的喜爱。
items.reference: Moutai is the most famous Chinese liquor, and on the eve of the founding of the People's Republic of China, it was selected as the official drink for state banquets. It is said that villagers along the Chishui River began to brew Moutai four thousand years ago. During the Western Han Dynasty, the local people produced high-quality Moutai and presented it to the emperor. Starting from the Tang Dynasty, this local liquor was shipped overseas via the Maritime Silk Road. Moutai has a mellow taste and a unique fragrance; when consumed in moderation, it can help relieve fatigue and has a calming effect, and thus it is very popular with consumers both at home and abroad.

During the Western Han Dynasty, the local people produced high-quality Moutai and presented it to the emperor. 4. 自唐朝开始，这种地方酒通过海上丝绸之路运往海外。
Starting from the Tang Dynasty, this local liquor was shipped overseas via the Maritime Silk Road. 5. 茅台味道柔和，有一种特殊的香味；适量饮用可以帮助缓解疲劳，有镇静作用，因而广受国 内外消费者的喜爱。

items.prompt: 茶拥有5000年的历史。传说，神农氏(Shen Nong)喝开水时，几片野树叶子落进壶里开水顿时散发出宜人的香味。他喝了几口，觉得很提神。茶就这样发现了。自此，茶在中国开始流行。茶园遍布全国，茶商变得富有。昂贵、雅致的茶具成了地位的象征。今天，茶不仅是一种健康的饮品，而且是中国文化的一个组成部分。越来越多的国际游客一边品茶，一边了解中国文化。
items.reference: Tea has a history of 5,000 years. It is said that, while Shen Nong was boiling water, several wild tea leaves fell into the pot, and the water immediately gave off a pleasant fragrance. He took a few sips and found it refreshing. Tea was thus discovered. Since then, tea began to gain popularity in China. Tea plantations spread across the country, and tea merchants became wealthy. Expensive and elegant tea sets became a symbol of status. Today, tea is not only a healthy drink but also an integral part of Chinese culture. An increasing number of international tourists learn about Chinese culture while sipping tea.

Tea was thus discovered. 5. 自此，茶在中国开始流行。

items.prompt: 你如果到北京旅游，必须做两件事∶一件是登长城，另一件是吃北京烤鸭。闻名遐迩的北京烤鸭曾仅限于宫廷，而现在北京数百家餐厅均有供应。 北京烤鸭源于600年前的明代。来自全国各地的厨师被挑选出来到京城为皇帝做饭。人们认为在皇宫做饭是一种莫大的荣誉，只有厨艺出众者才能获得这份工作。事实上，正是这些宫廷厨师使北京烤鸭的烹饪艺术日臻完善。
items.reference: If you travel to Beijing, you must do two things: climbing the Great Wall and eating Beijing roast duck. At that time, chefs from across the country were selected to come to the capital to cook for the emperor. It was considered a great honor to cook in the imperial palace, and only those with excellent cooking skills could get the job. In fact, it was these imperial court chefs that gradually perfected the cooking art of Beijing roast duck.

Beijing roast duck originated from the Ming Dynasty 600 years ago. 4. 来自全国各地的厨师被挑选出来到京城为皇帝做饭。
Chefs from across the country were selected to come to the capital to cook for the emperor. 5. 人们认为在皇宫做饭是一种莫大的荣誉，只有厨艺出众者才能获得这份工作。

items.paperTitle: 2020年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: 生活在中国不同地区的人们饮食多种多样。北方人主要吃面食，南方人大多吃米饭。在沿海地区，海鲜和淡水水产品在人们饮食中占有相当大的比例，而在其他地区人们的饮食中，肉类和奶制品更为常见。四川、湖南等省份的居民普遍爱吃辛辣食物，而江苏和浙江人更喜欢甜食。然而，因为烹任方式各异，同类食物的味道可能会有所不同。
items.reference: People living in different parts of China have diverse diets. People in the north mainly eat wheat- based foods, while those in the south mostly eat rice. In coastal areas, seafood and freshwater products make up a large proportion of people's diets, while in other regions, meat and dairy products are more common. Residents of provinces such as Sichuan and Hunan generally love spicy food, while people from Jiangsu and Zhejiang prefer sweet food. However, because cooking methods vary, the taste of the same food may differ.
keyPoints: People living in different parts of China have diverse diets. 2. 北方人主要吃面食，南方人大多吃米饭。
People in the north mainly eat wheat-based foods, while those in the south mostly eat rice. 3. 在沿海地区，海鲜和淡水水产品在人们饮食中占有相当大的比例，而在其他地区人们的饮食 中，肉类和奶制品更为常见。
In coastal areas, seafood and freshwater products make up a large proportion of people's diets, while in other regions, meat and dairy products are more common. 4. 四川、湖南等省份的居民普遍爱吃辛辣食物，而江苏和浙江人更喜欢甜食。

items.paperTitle: 2020年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: 春节前夕吃团圆饭是中国人的传统。团圆饭是一年中最重要的晚餐,也是家庭团聚的最佳时机,家人生活在不同地方的家庭尤其如此。团圆饭上的菜肴丰富多样,其中有些菜肴有特殊含义。例如,鱼是不可缺少的一道菜,因为汉语中的"鱼"字和"余"字听上去一样。在中国的许多地方,饺子也是一道重要的佳肴,因为饺子象征着财富和好运。
items.reference: It is a tradition for Chinese people to have the reunion dinner on Chinese New Year's Eve. The reunion dinner is the most important dinner of the year and also the best occasion for family reunion, especially for families whose members live in different places. The dishes served at the reunion dinner are rich and varied, some of which have special meanings. For example, fish is an indispensable dish, because the Chinese character for "fish" (yu) sounds the same as the character for "surplus" (yu). In many parts of China, dumplings are also an important dish, because they symbolize wealth and good luck.

items.paperTitle: 2020年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: 鱼是春节前夕餐桌上不可或缺的一道菜,因为汉语中"鱼"字的发音与"余"字的发音相同。正由于这个象征性的意义,春节期间鱼也作为礼物送给亲戚朋友。鱼的象征意义据说源于中国传统文化。中国人有节省的传统,他们认为节省得愈多,就感到愈为安全。今天,尽管人们愈来愈富裕了,但他们仍然认为节省是一种值得弘扬的美德。
items.reference: Fish is an indispensable dish on the dinner table on the Spring Festival Eve, because the Chinese character 鱼 (fish) has the same pronunciation as 余 (surplus). Because of this symbolic meaning, fish is also given as a gift to relatives and friends during the Spring Festival. The symbolic meaning of fish is said to originate from traditional Chinese culture. The Chinese have a tradition of being thrifty, and they believe that the more they save, the more secure they feel. Today, although people are getting richer and richer, they still believe that thrift is a virtue worth promoting.

items.prompt: 铁观音(Tieguanyin)是中国最受欢迎的茶之一,原产于福建省安溪县西坪镇,如今安溪全县普遍种植，但该县不同地区生产的铁观音又各具风味。铁观音一年四季均可采摘,尤以春秋两季采摘的茶叶品质最佳。铁观音的加工非常复杂,需要专门的技术和丰富的经验。铁观音含有多种维生素,喝起来口感独特。常饮铁观音有助于预防心脏病、降低血压、增强记忆力。

Drinking it regularly helps prevent heart disease, lower blood pressure, and improve memory.

items.prompt: 普洱(Pur'er)茶深受中国人喜爱。最好的普洱茶产自云南的西双版纳(Xishuangbanna)，那里的气候和环境为普洱茶树的生长提供了最佳条件。普洱茶颜色较深,味道与其他许多茶截然不同。普洱茶泡(brew)的时间越长越有味道。许多爱喝茶的人尤其喜欢其独特的香味和口感。普洱茶含有多种有益健康的元素,常饮普洱茶有助于保护心脏和血管,还有减肥、消除疲劳和促进消化的功效。
items.reference: Pu'er tea (also known as Pur'er tea) is deeply loved by the Chinese people. The best Pu'er tea comes from Xishuangbanna in Yunnan Province, where the climate and environment provide the ideal conditions for the growth of Pu'er tea trees. It has a darker color and a taste that is quite different from that of many other teas. The longer Pu'er tea is brewed, the more flavorful it becomes. Moreover, many tea lovers especially enjoy its unique aroma and taste. Pu'er tea contains many elements beneficial to health. Drinking it regularly helps protect the heart and blood vessels, and also helps lose weight, relieve fatigue and promote digestion.

items.prompt: 龙井(Longjing)是一种绿茶，主要产自中国东部沿海的浙江省。龙井茶独特的香味和口感为其赢得了"中国名茶"的称号，在中国深受大众的欢迎,在海外饮用的人也越来越多。龙井茶通常手工制作，其价格可能极其昂贵,也可能比较便宜，这取决于茶的生长地、采摘时间和制作工艺。龙井茶富含维生素C和其他多种有益健康的元素。经常喝龙井茶有助于减轻疲劳、延缓衰老。

Longjing tea is usually made by hand, and its price can be extremely high or relatively low, depending on where it grows, when it is picked, and how it is made. In addition, Longjing tea is rich in vitamin C and various other elements beneficial to health. Drinking it regularly helps relieve fatigue and delay aging.

items.prompt: 大运河 (Grand Canal) 是世界上最长的人工河，北起北京，南至杭州。它是中国历史上最宏伟的工程之一。大运河始建于公元前4世纪，公元13世纪末建成。修建之初是为了运输粮食，后来也用于运输其他商品。大运河沿线区域逐渐发展成为中国的工商业中心。长久以来，大运河对中国的经济发展发挥了重要作用，有力地促进了南北地区之间的人员往来和文化交流。
items.reference: The Grand Canal is the longest man-made river in the world, running from Beijing in the north to Hangzhou in the south. It is one of the most magnificent projects in Chinese history. The construction of the Grand Canal was started in the 4th century BC and completed in the late 13th century. It was originally built to transport grain and was later used to transport other goods as well. The areas along the Grand Canal gradually developed into industrial and commercial centers of China. For a long time, the Grand Canal has played an important role in China's economic development, greatly promoting personnel exchanges and cultural communication between the north and the south.
keyPoints: The Grand Canal is the longest man-made river in the world, running from Beijing in the north to Hangzhou in the south. 2. 它是中国历史上最宏伟的工程之一。
It is one of the most magnificent projects in Chinese history. 3. 大运河始建于公元前4世纪，公元13世纪末建成。
The construction of the Grand Canal was started in the 4th century BC and completed in the late 13th century. 4. 修建之初是为了运输粮食，后来也用于运输其他商品。
It was originally built to transport grain and was later used to transport other goods as well. 5. 大运河沿线区域逐渐发展成为中国的工商业中心。

items.prompt: 坎儿井(Karez)是新疆干旱地区的一种水利系统，由地下渠道将水井连接而成。该系统将春夏季节渗入 (seep into) 地下的大量雨水及积雪融水收集起来，通过山体的自然坡度引到地面，用于灌溉农田和满足人们的日常用水需求。坎儿井减少了水在地面的蒸发 (evaporation), 对地表破坏很小，因而有效地保护了自然资源与生态环境。坎儿井体现了我国人民与自然和谐共存的智慧，是对人类文明的一大贡献。
items.reference: Karez is a water conservancy system in the arid areas of Xinjiang, formed by underground channels that connect a series of wells. The system collects large amounts of rainwater and meltwater that seep into the ground in spring and summer, and channels them to the surface through the natural slope of the mountains to irrigate farmland and meet people's daily water needs. Karez reduces the evaporation of water from the ground and causes little damage to the surface, and thus effectively protects natural resources and the ecological environment. It embodies the wisdom of the Chinese people in living in harmony with nature, and is a great contribution to human civilization.
keyPoints: Karez is a water conservancy system in the arid areas of Xinjiang, formed by underground channels that connect a series of wells. 2. 该系统将春夏季节渗入 (seep into) 地下的大量雨水及积雪融水收集起来，通过山体的自然坡度 引到地面，用于灌溉农田和满足人们的日常用水需求。

Karez reduces the evaporation of water from the ground and causes little damage to the surface, and thus effectively protects natural resources and the ecological environment. 4. 坎儿井体现了我国人民与自然和谐共存的智慧，是对人类文明的一大贡献。

items.prompt: 都江堰 (Dujiangyan) 坐落在成都平原西部的岷江上，距成都市约50公里，始建于公元前三世纪。它的独特之处在于无需用堤坝调控水流。两千多年来,都江堰一直有效地发挥着防洪与灌溉作用，使成都平原成为旱涝保收的沃土和中国最重要的粮食产地之一。都江堰工程体现了我国人民与自然和谐共存的智慧，是全世界年代最久、仍在使用、无坝控水的水利工程。
items.reference: Dujiangyan, located on the Minjiang River in the western Chengdu Plain and about 50 kilometers from Chengdu, was first built in the 3rd century BC. Its uniqueness lies in controlling water flow without using dams. For more than 2,000 years, Dujiangyan has effectively served the functions of flood control and irrigation, making the Chengdu Plain a fertile land immune to drought and flood as well as one of the most important grain-producing areas in China. The Dujiangyan project embodies the wisdom of the Chinese people in living in harmony with nature, and it is the oldest water conservancy project in the world that is still in use and controls water flow without a dam.

items.prompt: 从前有个农夫嫌他种的禾苗长得慢，就到地里把禾苗一株株地拔高了一点。回家后他对家人说："今天可真把我累坏了！但我总算让禾苗一下子长高了。"他儿子到地里去一看，禾苗都已死光了。 现在有些家长急于让孩子成功，往往步那个农夫的后尘，搞得孩子苦不堪言，却不见孩子学业长进。这样的家长是否该对这个问题有所醒悟，让孩子自然成长呢？
items.reference: Once upon a time, a farmer, thinking that the rice seedlings he had planted were growing too slowly, went into the field and pulled them up one by one to make each a little taller. After returning home, he told his family, "I'm really worn out today, but I have finally made the rice seedlings grow taller all at once!" When his son went to the field, he found that all the rice seedlings had already withered. Nowadays, some parents, eager to see their children succeed, often follow in the farmer's footsteps, causing their children great suffering, yet seeing no progress in their studies. Shouldn't such parents wake up to this problem and let their children grow naturally?

items.prompt: 从前有个人养了一群羊。一天早上他准备出去放羊，发现少了一只。他仔细一看，看到羊栏(sheepfold) 上有个窟窿。显然，夜间有狼钻进羊圈叼走了羊。 邻居劝他修羊栏，可是他不听。 第二天，他发现狼又通过窟窿叼走一只羊。他想起邻居的话，就赶快堵上窟窿,把羊栏补好。此后，他的羊再也没有被狼叼走。 故事告诉我们:出了问题及时补救，可以防止蒙受更大损失。
items.reference: Long long ago, there was a man who raised a flock of sheep. One morning, when he was about to take the sheep out to graze, he found that one of them was missing. On a closer look, he saw that there was a hole in the sheepfold. Obviously, during the night a wolf had got into the sheepfold and carried off a sheep. His neighbour advised him to mend the sheepfold, but he would not listen. The next day, he found that another sheep had been carried off by the wolf through the hole. Remembering what his neighbour had said, he quickly blocked up the hole and mended the sheepfold. From then on, his sheep were never carried off by wolves again. The story tells us that fixing problems in time can prevent us from suffering greater losses.

On a closer look, he saw that there was a hole in the sheepfold. 4. 显然，夜间有狼钻进羊圈叼走了羊。
Obviously, during the night a wolf had got into the sheepfold and carried off a sheep. 5. 邻居劝他修羊栏，可是他不听。

items.prompt: 从前, 有个农夫正在地里耕作, 突然看见一只兔子飞奔而过，撞在一棵大树上死了。农夫毫不费力就吃到了兔肉, 心里非常高兴。他想, "如果总是这样该多好啊!" 于是，他不再耕作, 每天守候在那棵树旁，等待着能再捡到撞死在树上的兔子。他等呀等，等了一天又一天, 田地也荒芜了, 却再也没有等到第二只兔子。人们因而都嘲笑他把偶然当成了必然。
items.reference: Once upon a time, a farmer was working in his field when he suddenly saw a hare dash by and run into a big tree, where it was killed on the spot. As a result, the farmer got a hearty meal of rabbit meat without any effort and was overjoyed. He thought to himself, "How wonderful it would be if this could happen every day!" From then on, he gave up farming and stayed by that tree every day, hoping to pick up another hare that would crash into it and die. But days passed, his fields gradually became overgrown with weeds, yet no second hare ever came. People therefore laughed at him for taking a chance occurrence as an inevitable one.

items.prompt: 太极拳 (Taijiquan)起源于中国古代，是中国武术 (martial art) 的一个重要分支。练太极拳最初是为了自卫，现在是促进身心健康的有效锻炼方式。大量研究表明，这种锻炼方式有助于保持力量、灵活性和平衡力，并减少压力和焦虑。太极拳练习起来既容易又愉快，通过轻柔、流畅的动作，促使心情平静、头脑清晰。今天，太极拳已经传播到世界各地，深受广大健身者的喜爱。
items.reference: Taijiquan originated from ancient China and is an important branch of Chinese martial arts. Practicing Taijiquan was originally for self-defense, but it is now an effective form of exercise to promote physical and mental health. A large number of studies show that this form of exercise helps maintain strength, flexibility and balance, and reduce stress and anxiety. Taijiquan is both easy and enjoyable to practice, and with its gentle and flowing movements, it calms the mind and clears the head. Today, Taijiquan has spread to all parts of the world and is widely loved by fitness enthusiasts.

items.prompt: 按照中国民间的传统习俗，春节期间长辈通常会给孩子发红包，俗称发压岁钱 (lucky money), 以表达对孩子的祝福，祝他们好运。如今，红包不仅是给孩子的礼物，而且经常也是给长辈或亲朋好友的礼物。近年来，随着微信用户数量的增加，微信红包变得愈加流行。欢度春节时，人们经常互发微信红包表达问候。这无疑是一种与远方亲友联系的便捷方式。
items.reference: According to traditional Chinese folk customs, during the Spring Festival the elders usually give children red envelopes, commonly known as lucky money, to express their blessings and wish them good luck. Nowadays, red envelopes are not only a gift for children but also often a gift for the elders, relatives and friends. In recent years, with the increasing number of WeChat users, WeChat red envelopes have become increasingly popular. When celebrating the Spring Festival, people often send WeChat red envelopes to each other to express their greetings. This is undoubtedly a convenient way of staying in touch with relatives and friends far away.

items.prompt: 戏曲是一种中国传统的艺术形式，可以追溯到唐朝。中国戏曲吸引观众的一大特色是其独具风格的脸谱 (facial painting)。脸谱代表不同角色的性格和命运。观众通过观察脸谱能够更好地理解这些角色的故事。欣赏戏曲是中国人特别是老年人的一大乐趣。为了吸引更多的年轻观众，传统戏曲正在不断地发展和创新。如今，越来越多的外国观众也喜欢中国戏曲。
items.reference: Chinese opera is a traditional Chinese art form, which dates back to the Tang Dynasty. A major feature of Chinese opera that attracts audiences is its uniquely styled facial painting. Facial paintings represent the personalities and destinies of different characters. By observing the facial paintings, the audience can better understand the stories of these characters. Appreciating Chinese opera is a major pleasure for Chinese people, especially the elderly. items.prompt: 改革开放以来，中国人的饮食(diet)发生了显著变化。过去由于经济落后，食品种类有限、数量不足 ，人们仅仅满足于吃得饱。如今中国经济快速发展，食品不仅更加丰富多样，质量也大幅提高。随着生活水平不断提升，人们对饮食的要求越来越高，更加注重吃得营养健康。因此，目前市场上推出的低脂、低糖、有机食品受到人们的普遍欢迎。
items.reference: Since the reform and opening-up, the diet of Chinese people has undergone significant changes. In the past, due to the backward economy, food was limited in variety and insufficient in quantity, so people were content with merely having enough to eat. Today, with China's economy developing rapidly, food is not only more abundant and diverse but also greatly improved in quality. As living standards keep rising, people have increasingly higher demands for their diet and pay more attention to eating in a nutritious and healthy way. Therefore, the low-fat, low-sugar and organic food launched on the market today is widely welcomed by people.

items.paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: 改革开放以来，中国人民生活水平不断提高，这在人们的饮食 (diet)变化上得到充分体现 。如今，人们不再满足于吃得饱，而是追求吃得更加安全、更加营养、更加健康，食物也愈来愈丰富多样，不再限于本地的农产品。物流业 (logistics industry)的发展使人们很容易品尝到全国各地的特产。毫无疑问，食品质量与饮食结构的改善为增进人们健康提供了有力的保障。
items.reference: Since the reform and opening-up, the living standards of the Chinese people have improved steadily, which is fully reflected in the changes in people's diet. Food is also becoming more and more diverse, no longer being limited to local agricultural products. The development of the logistics industry makes it easy for people to taste specialties from all over the country. Undoubtedly, the improvement in food quality and diet structure provides a strong guarantee for improving people's health.

items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: 四合院(siheyuan)是中国一种传统的住宅建筑，其特点是房屋建造在一个院子的四周，将院子合围在中间。四合院通常冬暖夏凉，环境舒适，尤其适合大家庭居住。四合院在中国各地有多种类型，其中以北京的四合院最为典型。如今，随着现代城市的发展，传统的四合院已逐渐减少，但因其独特的建筑风格，四合院对中国文化的传承和中国历史的研究具有重要意义。
items.reference: The siheyuan is a traditional Chinese residential building, characterized by houses built on the four sides of a courtyard, enclosing it in the middle. It is usually warm in winter and cool in summer, providing a comfortable environment that is especially suitable for large families. There are various types of siheyuan across China, among which the ones in Beijing are the most typical. Nowadays, with the development of modern cities, traditional siheyuan have gradually decreased; however, owing to their unique architectural style, they remain of great significance to the inheritance of Chinese culture and the study of Chinese history.

It is usually warm in winter and cool in summer, providing a comfortable environment that is especially suitable for large families. 3. 四合院在中国各地有多种类型，其中以北京的四合院最为典型。
There are various types of siheyuan across China, among which the ones in Beijing are the most typical. 4. 如今，随着现代城市的发展，传统的四合院已逐渐减少，但因其独特的建筑风格，四合院对 中国文化的传承和中国历史的研究具有重要意义。

items.title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: 农历 (the lunar calendar) 起源于数千年前的中国，根据太阳和月亮的运行规律制定。长期以来，农历在农业生产和人们日常生活中发挥着重要作用。古人依据农历记录日期、安排农活，以便最有效地利用自然资源和气候条件，提高农作物的产量和质量。中国的春节、中秋节等传统节日的日期都基于农历。农历是中国传统文化的重要组成部分，当今依然广为使用。
items.reference: The lunar calendar originated in China thousands of years ago and was formulated based on the movements of the sun and the moon. For a long time, it has played an important role in agricultural production and people's daily life. In the past, ancient people recorded dates and arranged farm work according to the lunar calendar, in order to make the most effective use of natural resources and climatic conditions, thereby improving the yield and quality of crops. The dates of China's traditional festivals, such as the Spring Festival and the Mid-Autumn Festival, are based on the lunar calendar. As an important part of traditional Chinese culture, the lunar calendar is still widely used today.
keyPoints: The lunar calendar originated in China thousands of years ago and was formulated based on the movements of the sun and the moon. 2. 长期以来，农历在农业生产和人们日常生活中发挥着重要作用。
For a long time, the lunar calendar has played an important role in agricultural production and people's daily life. 3. 古人依据农历记录日期、安排农活，以便最有效地利用自然资源和气候条件，提高农作物的 产量和质量。

Ancient people recorded dates and arranged farm work according to the lunar calendar, in order to make the most effective use of natural resources and climatic conditions, thereby improving the yield and quality of crops. 4. 中国的春节、中秋节等传统节日的日期都基于农历。
The dates of China's traditional festivals, such as the Spring Festival and the Mid- Autumn Festival, are based on the lunar calendar. 5. 农历是中国传统文化的重要组成部分，当今依然广为使用。

items.title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: 汉语中的 "福"字 (the character fu)表示幸福和好运,是中国传统文化中最常用的吉祥(auspicious) 符号之一。人们通常将一个大大的福字写在红纸上, 寓意期盼家庭幸福、社会安定、国家昌盛。春节贴福字是民间由来已久的习俗。为了欢庆春节, 家家户户都会将福字贴在门上或墙上, 表达对幸福生活的向往、对美好未来的期待。人们有时还将福字倒过来贴，表示幸福已到、好运已到。
items.reference: The Chinese character "Fu" means happiness and good fortune, and is one of the most commonly used auspicious symbols in traditional Chinese culture. People usually write a large character "Fu" on red paper, expressing their wish for family happiness, social stability and national prosperity. Pasting the character "Fu" during the Spring Festival is a long-standing folk custom. To celebrate the Spring Festival, every household pastes the character "Fu" on doors or walls, expressing their longing for a happy life and their expectation for a better future. Sometimes people also paste the character "Fu" upside down to indicate that happiness and good fortune have arrived.
keyPoints: The Chinese character "Fu" means happiness and good fortune, and is one of the most commonly used auspicious symbols in traditional Chinese culture. 2. 人们通常将一个大大的福字写在红纸上,寓意期盼家庭幸福、社会安定、国家昌盛。
People usually write a large character "Fu" on red paper, expressing their wish for family happiness, social stability and national prosperity. 3. 春节贴福字是民间由来已久的习俗。
Pasting the character "Fu" during the Spring Festival is a long-standing folk custom. 4. 为了欢庆春节,家家户户都会将福字贴在门上或墙上,表达对幸福生活的向往、对美好未来的 期待。

To celebrate the Spring Festival, every household pastes the character "Fu" on doors or walls, expressing their longing for a happy life and their expectation for a better future. 5. 人们有时还将福字倒过来贴，表示幸福已到、好运已到。

items.prompt: 中国政府十分重视环境保护。近年来,中国在减少空气、水和土壤污染上取得了显著成效。为了不断改善人们的生活环境,中国采取了一系列有效措施,包括大力发展清洁能源,改善公共交通,推广共享单车,实施垃圾分类。通过这些措施,中国的城市和农村正在绿起来、美起来。中国还积极参与国际合作,为全球环境保护做出了重要贡献。
items.reference: The Chinese government attaches great importance to environmental protection. In recent years, China has made remarkable progress in reducing air, water and soil pollution. items.prompt: 敦煌莫高窟 (Mogao Grottoes) 数字展示中心于2014年开放启用, 是莫高窟保护利用工程的重要组成部分。展示中心采用数字技术和多媒体展示手段, 使游客进入洞窟参观之前就能了解莫高窟的历史文化, 鉴赏莫高窟的艺术经典。这将减少开放洞窟的数量, 缩短游客在洞窟内的逗留时间, 减轻参观对莫高窟造成的影响, 以使这一世界文化遗产得到妥善保护、长久利用。
items.reference: The Mogao Grottoes Digital Exhibition Center, which opened in 2014, is an important part of the project for the protection and utilization of the Mogao Grottoes. The center adopts digital technology and multimedia means, enabling visitors to learn about the history and culture of the Mogao Grottoes and appreciate its artistic classics before they enter the caves. This will reduce the number of open caves, shorten the time visitors stay inside, and lessen the impact of visits on the Mogao Grottoes, so that this World Cultural Heritage site can be properly protected and used over the long term.

items.paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: 被誉为"杂交水稻(hybrid rice)之父"的袁隆平和他的科研团队克服重重困难,研发出了一种超级杂交水稻。这项技术获得了举世公认的巨大成功。通过这项技术的应用,水稻抗旱抗病能力更强,能适应不同的气候和土壤条件,产量可提高20-30%。超级杂交水稻营养丰富,口感更佳。目前,这项技术已经在许多国家得到广泛应用,为全球粮食安全做出了重大贡献。
items.reference: Yuan Longping, known as the father of hybrid rice, and his research team, overcoming numerous difficulties, developed a super hybrid rice. This technology has achieved great success recognized worldwide. With the application of this technology, the rice has stronger resistance to drought and disease and can adapt to different climates and soil conditions, and its yield can increase by 20 to 30 percent. In addition, super hybrid rice is rich in nutrition and tastes better. Currently, this technology has been widely applied in many countries, making great contributions to global food security.

Ice and snow tourism is making an increasingly great contribution to the local economic development. 英语四级 2025年6月·第2套 · 全卷构成 Part I 写作 题目解析 → Part II 听力 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section A 完形填空（选词填空） 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section B 长篇阅读（信息匹配） 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section C 阅读理解（四选一） 题目解析 → Part Ⅲ Section C (2) 阅读理解（四选一） 题目解析 → Part IV 汉译英（段落翻译） 本题

items.prompt: 近年来，"城市漫步(city walk)"在中国的年轻人中悄然兴起，已成为一种旅游新潮流。与传统旅游不同，城市漫步不追求在短时间内游览尽可能多的景点。而是随意行走或按照主题路线漫步在城市的大街小巷。漫步者品尝地道小吃，欣赏特色建筑，了解当地生活方式。他们还用相机或手机记录城市的风景和人物。这种旅游方式能让城市漫步者更深入了解城市的历史与文化。

items.prompt: 中国有句老话："一日为师，终身为父"。在中国人的观念里，老师不仅传授知识，更教给学生做人的道理。在古代，学生初次见老师时要举行隆重的仪式，足见老师地位之高。为弘扬尊师的优良传统，中国从1985年开始将每年的9月10日定为教师节。在这一天，学生以各种方式表达对老师的敬意。尊师是中华民族的传统美德，在当今社会得到了发扬光大。
items.reference: There is an old Chinese saying: "A teacher for a day is a father for a lifetime." To carry forward the fine tradition of respecting teachers, China has observed September 10 of each year as Teachers' Day since 1985. On this day, students express their respect for teachers in various ways. Respecting teachers is a traditional virtue of the Chinese nation, and it has been carried forward in today's society.

items.prompt: 餐桌礼仪 (dining etiquette) 是中华传统文化的重要组成部分，蕴含着热情有礼的待客之道。为了招待客人，主人会根据客人的口味和喜好准备丰富精致的菜肴。就餐座位的安排非常讲究，主人坐在正对大门的位置，在主人身边就座的是最重要的客人。进餐时，主人会不时地为客人添酒加菜。这种独特的餐桌礼仪已延续了数千年，对促进和谐的人际交往起到了重要的作用。
items.reference: Dining etiquette is an important part of traditional Chinese culture, embodying the warm and courteous way of treating guests. During the meal, he refills wine and adds more dishes for the guests from time to time. This unique dining etiquette has lasted for thousands of years and has played an important role in promoting harmonious interpersonal relationships.

items.prompt: 在中国传统文化中，亲朋好友之间互赠礼物是人际交往的一种重要礼节 (etiquette) 。赠送礼物不仅是物质的馈赠，更是情感的表达，是维系人际关系的重要纽带。一份精心挑选、符合接受者喜好的礼物，往往能加深彼此的感情。中国人遵循"礼尚往来" (mutually exchanging courtesies)的传统，接受礼物时会表达谢意，并适时回赠礼物，以增进彼此的融洽关系。
items.reference: In traditional Chinese culture, exchanging gifts among relatives and close friends is an important form of etiquette in interpersonal communication. Giving gifts is not only a material offering, but also an expression of affection, and an important bond that maintains interpersonal relationships. Such a carefully chosen gift that suits the recipient's preferences can often deepen mutual affection. Chinese people follow the tradition of reciprocity (mutually exchanging courtesies): when receiving gifts, they express their gratitude and return gifts at an appropriate time, so as to enhance their harmonious relationship.
