items.reference: Are people becoming addicted to technology? My answer is a definite yes. As numerous studies claim that addiction to technology is real, this problem deserves our serious attention. Signs of such addiction are everywhere in daily life. Many people check their smartphones the moment they wake up and keep scrolling short videos until midnight. While technology is designed to make life easier, an increasing number of us feel anxious once we are separated from our screens. As a result, real conversations, sleep and study are all disturbed, which shows that our reliance has quietly turned into dependence. In my view, therefore, people are indeed getting hooked on technology. However, this does not mean we should abandon it. What matters is to use technology in a rational way, setting limits on screen time and leaving room for the real world.
keyPoints: 开门见山表态到位。首句直接回应标题问句、用 My answer is a definite yes 亮立场，落实 了‘开门见山表态’；再借 As numerous studies claim ... 化用参考素材引出话题，避免了整段照抄。
现象分析两不缺。先用 check their smartphones the moment they wake up 等具体画面 摆现象，再用 While ... 让步转折、As a result ... which shows that ... 因果回扣，完整走了‘现象—分析 —回扣’三步，没停在罗列现象。
重申加建议收束。用 people are indeed getting hooked 换词重申立场，再以 However ... what matters is to ... 退一步给出设屏幕时间上限的建议，落实了‘重申＋落地建议’，首尾呼应。

items.title: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay titled“Is technology making people lazy?”.The statement given below is for your reference. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words . Many studies claim that computers distract people, make them lazy thinkers and even lower their work efficiency.
items.reference: Is technology making people lazy? My answer is a qualified yes: while technology itself is neutral, the way most of us use it does breed laziness of both mind and body. To begin with, technology encourages mental laziness. When a search engine can answer any question in seconds and a navigation app can guide every turn, few people bother to think, memorize or reason on their own. Gradually, we outsource our brains and lose the habit of deep thinking. Physical laziness follows the same logic: with delivery apps and online services, many people rarely walk, cook or move, so their bodies grow as idle as their minds. Admittedly, technology can also make us more efficient. Yet the tool is not to blame; our passive dependence is. Therefore, the real question is not whether technology makes us lazy, but whether we control it or let it control us. Used wisely, it frees us; used blindly, it enslaves us.
keyPoints: 首段亮辩证立场。以题目设问 “Is technology making people lazy?” 开头，“My answer is a qualified yes” 直接表态，“while technology itself is neutral” 用 while 让步定调，落实了首段“设问 —表态—定调”的功能，并用 “both mind and body” 一句点出两条线。
两例论证＋回扣懒。“To begin with, technology encourages mental laziness” 亮出分论 点，用 search engine、navigation app 当例子；“Physical laziness follows the same logic” 递进接上 第二例，两条线都落回 laziness，实现主体段“主题句—例子—让步—回扣”。
归因于人并升华。“Yet the tool is not to blame; our passive dependence is” 把责任从科 技转到人，“Used wisely, it frees us; used blindly, it enslaves us” 用对照句升华，收束辩证立场，呼应 开头。

items.title: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2021年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay titled “Doviolent video games lead to violence?”. The statement given below is for your reference. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words . A growing body of research finds that violent video games can make kids act aggressively in their real world relationships, causing an increase in violence.
items.reference: Do violent video games lead to violence? While a growing body of research suggests such games can make players more aggressive, I believe they do not directly cause real violence; rather, their influence depends on the individual and the surrounding environment. To begin with, exposure to violent scenes may indeed shape behavior. First, children who spend hours shooting and fighting on screen can gradually treat aggression as normal, and some may copy what they see when they lose their temper. However, most players clearly separate games from reality. A well-supervised teenager, for instance, can enjoy an action game after homework and still behave kindly toward classmates, because family guidance and self-control matter far more than the game itself. In conclusion, violent video games alone do not turn ordinary people into violent ones. What truly counts is proper parental supervision and healthy habits. Therefore, rather than simply blaming the games, parents and schools should teach children to play in moderation and to tell fantasy from real life.
keyPoints: 首段落实开门见山亮立场。开头 'Do violent video games lead to violence?' 用问句引 题，'While a growing body of research suggests...' 用 While 让步嵌入研究，'I believe they do not directly cause real violence' 一句亮出辩证立场，正好落实 outline 第一段的『引题表态』。

主体段走完让步-反例。'To begin with, exposure to violent scenes may indeed shape behavior' 先让步承认坏处，'However, most players clearly separate games from reality' 转折，再 用 'A well-supervised teenager, for instance...' 举例回扣中心，观点-理由-例证-回扣四步齐全。

尾段重申加建议。'In conclusion, violent video games alone do not turn ordinary people into violent ones' 换词重申立场，'Therefore, rather than simply blaming the games, parents and schools should teach children to play in moderation' 给出可操作建议，收束有力。

items.title: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose your school is organizing an orientation program to help the freshmen adapt to the new environment and academic studies. You are now to write a proposal, which may include its aim, duration, participants and activities. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: A Proposal for the Freshmen Orientation Program Our school is planning an orientation program for this year's freshmen, and its main arrangements are proposed below. The program aims to help new students adapt to the new environment and academic studies as smoothly and quickly as possible. In terms of duration, the program will last for one week, starting from the day of registration. As for the participants, it is open to all incoming freshmen, and it will be organized by the Student Union together with volunteer seniors and several advisers from each department. A variety of activities will be arranged during the week. First, campus tours and library workshops will help newcomers find their way around. Second, group meetings with academic advisers will introduce course selection and effective study methods. Finally, evening social parties will give students a chance to make new friends and relax. We are confident that this program will give every freshman a warm and confident start. Your approval and support would be highly appreciated. The Student Union
keyPoints: 标题＋主旨句落地。本段用标题 A Proposal for the Freshmen Orientation Program 点 题，开头句 our school is planning ... arrangements are proposed below 总起，再用 The program aims to help new students adapt ... 把 aim 前置，正是『开头一句亮方案主旨』方法的落地。

两标签领出两要点。In terms of duration 领出『one week, starting from the day of registration』写死时长，As for the participants 领出『all incoming freshmen』『organized by the Student Union ...』写清人员，一句一要点，覆盖 duration 与 participants。

First/Second/Finally 写实活动。先用 A variety of activities will be arranged 总起，再以 First / Second / Finally 分列三类活动，且每条都补了作用（help newcomers find their way around、introduce course selection、make new friends），实现『分点罗列活动』且不空泛。
信心＋请求＋组织落款。We are confident that ... a warm and confident start 表信心并回 扣目的，Your approval and support would be highly appreciated 客气请求批准，末行以 The Student Union 落款，避免出现真名。

items.title: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university student union is planning to hold a speech contest. You are now to write a proposal for organizing the contest. The proposal may include the topic, aim , procedure and selection of contestants. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: A Proposal for a Speech Contest On behalf of the Student Union, I am writing to propose that our university hold a campus speech contest next month, and the details are outlined below for your approval. The contest will focus on the theme "My Chinese Dream." Our aim is to sharpen students' public-speaking skills, build their confidence, and enrich campus cultural life. As for the procedure, we will first post a notice to call for entries. Then a preliminary round will be held in each college. Finally, twelve finalists will deliver their speeches on stage, scored by a panel of teachers and students. The selection of contestants will be fair and open: applicants must submit a written draft, and those with clear ideas and fluent expression will be shortlisted through a short interview. We sincerely hope you will approve this proposal, and any suggestions would be warmly welcomed. The Student Union
keyPoints: 标题＋首句表来意。标题 A Proposal for a Speech Contest 一眼点题；首句 On behalf of the Student Union, I am writing to propose that... 落实了「首句报身份表来意」，并用 outlined below for your approval 预告下文、点明请批目的。
主题＋目的两要点。The contest will focus on the theme "My Chinese Dream." 先定主 题；Our aim is to sharpen... build... and enrich... 用并列结构一次说清三个办赛目的，落实「先定主题 再讲意义」。
序数词分步写流程。As for the procedure 总起，first... Then... Finally... 把报名、初赛、决 赛三步依次串起，条理清晰，落实「序数词串起流程」。

补选拔＋礼貌收尾。The selection of contestants will be fair and open 单独交代最易漏的 选拔要点；结尾 We sincerely hope you will approve... and any suggestions would be warmly welcomed 请批并欢迎反馈，末署 The Student Union，落实「补齐选拔再礼貌收尾」。

items.title: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2021年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose you have just participated in a school project of collecting used books on campus. You are now to write a report about the project, which may include its aim, organizers, participants and activities. You will have 30 minutes to write the report. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: A Report on the Used-Book Collection Last week, a book-collecting project was successfully carried out on our campus, aiming to give idle used books a second life and to help students in need. By gathering textbooks and novels that lay unused on shelves, the project hoped to promote recycling and ease the burden of buying new books. The project was organized by the Student Union, with strong support from the school library. It attracted a wide range of participants: undergraduates from every department, several teachers, and a group of enthusiastic volunteers. Together they set up donation booths, sorted and classified the collected books, and recorded each contribution carefully. Some volunteers also repaired damaged covers and delivered the books to a nearby rural school. Thanks to everyone's effort, more than two thousand books were collected. The activity not only enriched the campus reading atmosphere but also spread the spirit of sharing and thrift among students.
keyPoints: 总览开场并带出目的。"Last week, a book-collecting project was successfully carried out on our campus" 用一句话交代时间、地点与事件，随后 "aiming to give idle used books a second life and to help students in need" 用分词短语接出目的，落实了首段"先总览后点目的"的方法 与 aim 要点。

分点写清组织者参与者活动。"was organized by the Student Union" 被动交代组织者， 冒号后 "undergraduates... several teachers, and a group of... volunteers" 列举参与者，"set up... sorted and classified... and recorded..." 三个过去式动词并列铺开活动，一段之内把三个要点全部 对上。
成果加意义收束。"more than two thousand books were collected" 给出可感知的成 果，"not only enriched... but also spread..." 把意义升一层收尾，呼应首段目的，符合"结尾亮成果收意 义"的蓝图。

items.title: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose you are going to write a proposal to your school library for improving its service. You are to write about its current problems and possible solutions to these problems. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: I am a sophomore who spends most of my free time studying in our school library. As a frequent user, I am writing to propose several improvements that I believe would enhance its service. Two problems stand out. First, the library closes at nine every evening, which is too early for students who prepare for exams late at night; I suggest extending the opening hours to eleven during examination weeks. Second, the reading area is often noisy because there is no separated quiet zone, so it is hard to concentrate. It would be advisable to set aside a silent room and remind readers to keep their voices down. I believe these changes are simple yet effective, and they would make the library far more welcoming to every student. Thank you very much for considering my suggestions, and I sincerely hope they can be adopted soon.
keyPoints: 身份＋目的一句到位。用‘I am a sophomore who…’自报身份、‘I am writing to propose…’直接点明目的，落实了开头段‘亮身份点目的’的功能，呼应 improving its service，没有多余 铺垫。
First/Second 问题紧跟对策。‘Two problems stand out. First… I suggest…; Second… It would be advisable to…’两组都是问题后立刻接对策，把 current problems and possible solutions to these problems 一一写全，且用了建议式表达保持客气。
价值＋致谢收尾。‘simple yet effective… Thank you very much for considering… I sincerely hope they can be adopted’先讲好处再礼貌致谢，体现建议书的建设性与得体，收束干净。

items.title: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose you are going to write a proposal to your student union for enriching students’ extracurricular activities. You are to write about what activities to organize and why. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: A Proposal on Enriching Extracurricular Activities I am writing to propose a few extracurricular activities that our student union could organize, in the hope of making our campus life more colorful and rewarding. To begin with, I would suggest holding a monthly book-sharing club. Since many of us read alone and seldom exchange thoughts, such a club would offer a regular chance to share insights, broaden our horizons and improve our critical thinking. In addition, I recommend arranging weekend volunteer trips to nearby communities. These activities would not only allow us to apply what we learn in real life, but also cultivate a stronger sense of social responsibility and teamwork among students. I sincerely hope the student union will take these suggestions into consideration. Your support would mean a great deal to all of us. Thank you for your time and attention.
keyPoints: 标题＋目的句。首行用标题 A Proposal on Enriching Extracurricular Activities 点题，正文 以 I am writing to propose... 落实'开门见山提目的'，一句话交代来意与大方向。
建议一配理由。To begin with, I would suggest holding a monthly book-sharing club 抛 出活动，Since many of us read alone... would offer a regular chance to share insights 紧跟理由， 落实'主张＋理由'两步。
建议二双重益处。In addition, I recommend arranging weekend volunteer trips 追加第 二项，用 not only allow us to apply what we learn... but also cultivate a stronger sense of social responsibility 把'为什么办'说得立体。
呼吁并致谢。I sincerely hope the student union will take these suggestions into consideration 请求采纳，末句 Thank you for your time and attention 致谢收束，稳住 proposal 的 语气。

items.title: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose you are going to write a proposal to your school clinic for improving its service. You are to write about its current problems and possible solutions to these problems. You will have 30 minutes to write the proposal. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Dear School Administration, I am a student of our university, and I am writing to put forward a few suggestions on improving the service of our school clinic, which I hope will make it more helpful to all students. At present, the clinic faces several problems. First, registration often takes a long time, so students have to wait in a long line before seeing a doctor. Second, the medical staff are too few, which makes the service slow. Besides, the range of available medicines is quite limited, and the opening hours are inconvenient for those with classes in the daytime. To solve these problems, some measures could be taken. It is suggested that an online registration system be set up to save waiting time. In addition, the clinic could hire more doctors and nurses and stock a wider range of common medicines. Extending the opening hours into the evening would also be a great help. I would appreciate it if these suggestions could be considered. Yours sincerely, Li Ming
keyPoints: 开门见山点目的。用 I am writing to put forward a few suggestions on improving the service of our school clinic 一句同时自报身份与来意，落实『开篇一句点目的』，直接扣住任务 improving its service。
序数词分点摆问题。First... Second... Besides... 把挂号久、人手少、药品少、时间不便逐条 摆清，落实『问题分点摆事实』，覆盖 its current problems。
对策逐条呼应。It is suggested that an online registration system be set up 等对策与上 段问题一一对应，落实『对策对号入座』，覆盖 possible solutions to these problems。
礼貌收束加落款。I would appreciate it if these suggestions could be considered 客气收 尾，再以化名落款，落实『礼貌收束表期待』，守住建设性语气。

items.title: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university is selecting some students to teach kids in remote rural areas during the coming vacation. You are now to write an application letter to the university to explain why you want to take part and what you can do for the kids. You will have 30 minutes to write the letter. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Dear Sir or Madam, I am writing to apply for the position of a volunteer teacher for children in remote rural areas during the coming vacation. The main reason I want to take part is my genuine love for education. Two years ago, I tutored a left-behind child in my hometown, and watching her grow more confident convinced me that teaching can truly change lives. Joining this program is my way of giving back to society. As for what I can do, I major in English, so I am confident that I can teach the kids basic spoken English and help them with their homework. Besides, I enjoy singing and drawing, and I would like to organize after-class activities to make learning both fun and warm for them. I would sincerely appreciate it if I could be given this valuable chance. Thank you for your time and consideration. Yours sincerely, Li Hua
keyPoints: 称呼立格式。首行 Dear Sir or Madam, 落实『顶格称呼定语域』,一眼确立这是正式信件、 定下语域。
来意＋经历撑动机。先 I am writing to apply for... 表来意,再用『Two years ago, I tutored a left-behind child... convinced me that teaching can truly change lives』的亲身经历坐实动机,兑现 『先来意后讲理由』,答满第一个任务点。
一硬一软配需求。As for what I can do 过渡后,给出『teach the kids basic spoken English』(硬)与『organize after-class activities』(软)两项贡献,落实『能力配需求』,答满第二个任 务点。
情态动词软化语气。用 would/could(『I would sincerely appreciate it if I could be given this valuable chance』)委婉表期待,再一句致谢,兑现『礼貌收束致谢』。

items.title: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose your class has just finished celebrating the Teachers'Day. You are now to write a report to the university newspaper on the celebration activities organized by your class. You will have 30 minutes to write the report.You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: A Report on Teachers' Day Celebration On September 10th, our class held a warm celebration to mark Teachers' Day and to show our gratitude to all our teachers. The event took place in Classroom 305 and was attended by every student as well as three of our subject teachers. The celebration was filled with carefully prepared activities. To begin with, we decorated the classroom with balloons and handwritten cards. Then several students performed songs and a short play, while others presented flowers and small gifts. What moved everyone most was a video in which we collected our thanks to our teachers. The celebration turned out to be a great success. Our teachers were deeply touched, and some of them could hardly hold back their tears. Through this activity, we not only expressed our respect but also drew closer to one another. It was surely a Teachers' Day none of us will ever forget.
keyPoints: 导语落实who-when-what。首句「On September 10th, our class held a warm celebration to mark Teachers' Day」一句答清何时、谁、办了什么，正是导语式开门见山；次句补出地 点 Classroom 305 与参与者，落实了 outline 第一段「标题＋导语」的功能，全程一般过去时。

顺序词＋具体活动填满内容。主题句「filled with carefully prepared activities」总起，随后 用 To begin with / Then / while 把装饰教室、表演节目、献花送礼一件件列清，再用「What moved everyone most was a video」点出亮点，把庆祝活动写得具体可感，兑现了本段「用such as把活动写 具体」的方法。
效果加意义收尾。「turned out to be a great success」先给总评，再写老师落泪的反响， 最后用「not only ... but also ...」升华到表达敬意、拉近师生关系，以一句难忘作结，落实「以反响收束 升意义」。

items.title: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2022年9月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose your class plans to invite some former graduates to share their job experiences with the students. As the organizer of the activity, you are now to write an invitation letter to the invited speakers on behalf of your class. You will have 30 minutes to write the letter.You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Dear Sir or Madam, On behalf of Class One, I am writing to cordially invite you to our upcoming career-sharing session. As a distinguished graduate of our school who has achieved much in the workplace, you are exactly the speaker our students long to hear from. Our class is organizing this activity because many current students feel anxious about job hunting and future careers. We believe your first-hand experience in seeking employment and adapting to work would offer them invaluable guidance and encouragement. The talk is scheduled for 2:00 p.m. next Friday in Lecture Hall 3, and will last about an hour, followed by a free question-and-answer session. It would mean a great deal to us if you could accept this invitation. Please kindly reply by email before this Wednesday to confirm your attendance. We sincerely look forward to your inspiring presence. Yours sincerely, Li Ming
keyPoints: 顶格称呼到位。Dear Sir or Madam, 顶格单独成行，落实「按正式度选称呼」，未知姓名用 通用正式称呼，拿稳格式分。
首句即亮邀请。On behalf of Class One, I am writing to cordially invite you... 开门见山点 明代表全班发出邀请；接着 As a distinguished graduate... you are exactly the speaker 抬高受邀人价 值，切题又礼貌。
缘由加细节自足。先用 because many current students feel anxious... 交代缘由，再用 scheduled for 2:00 p.m. next Friday in Lecture Hall 3 给全时间、地点、时长，信息自足，也把字数撑 起来。
委婉邀约留回复。It would mean a great deal to us if you could... 委婉发出邀约，Please kindly reply by email before this Wednesday 给出回复方式与截止，姿态谦逊得体。

items.title: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: In this task, you are to write an essay on the role of physical exercise in achieving success at college. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: While many college students bury themselves in books and treat workouts as a waste of time, it is often overlooked that physical exercise plays an indispensable role in achieving success at college. In my view, staying active is not the enemy of study but its solid foundation. First, regular exercise strengthens the body and guarantees the energy that intense coursework demands. A student who jogs every morning is more likely to stay focused through back-to-back lectures than one who never moves. Moreover, working out is a powerful way to relieve stress. When exams and job hunting pile up, a quick run on the track can wash away tension and rebuild mental resilience. In addition, sticking to a fixed exercise routine cultivates self-discipline, and this habit naturally transfers to managing study plans on time. In short, physical exercise is by no means a distraction; rather, it is the cornerstone of college success. Therefore, every student is advised to fit regular workouts into daily life before body and mind break down.
keyPoints: 现象引入加亮立场。本段先用 While many college students bury themselves in books 引 出忽视锻炼的普遍现象，再用 physical exercise plays an indispensable role in achieving success at college 斩钉截铁亮出立场，落实了第一段『亮明立场』的功能，且把题眼 role 直接写进首段。
三角度各带场景。本段用 First / Moreover / In addition 串起身体、心理、自律三个角度， 每个角度都配了校园场景（晨跑保持专注、操场短跑驱散紧张、固定作息培养自律），落实了『主题句加 理由加例子加小结』的论证方法，避免了只喊口号。
否定误解再呼吁。本段用 by no means a distraction; rather, it is the cornerstone 否定误 解、重申立场，再用 every student is advised to fit regular workouts into daily life 发出行动呼吁， 落实了结尾段『重申加呼吁』的功能。

items.title: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: In this task, you are to write an essay on the importance o f developing a healthy lifestyle among college students. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: A healthy lifestyle plays a vital role in the life of every college student. As campus life grows busier with assignments and screens, I firmly believe that keeping fit, eating well and sleeping regularly is not a trivial habit but the very foundation of a successful university experience. For one thing, a sound body directly boosts learning efficiency. A student who stays up all night rushing a due date and lives on takeout will struggle to concentrate the next morning, while regular exercise and balanced meals keep the mind sharp in class. For another, a healthy routine stabilizes our emotions. Sitting still for hours breeds anxiety, whereas a short run often washes away the pressure of exams and eases loneliness far from home. In conclusion, a healthy lifestyle is not optional but essential for college students. The sooner we build it, the more energy and confidence we will carry into our studies and future lives.
keyPoints: 观点前置立中心。首句 A healthy lifestyle plays a vital role 直接落实「亮明重要性观点」句 架，观点前置；第二句用 not a trivial habit but the very foundation 抬高立场，完成 outline 的「开 门见山亮立场」功能。
两理由各配场景。用 For one thing / For another 领起效率与情绪两个分论点，各配 stays up all night rushing a due date、lives on takeout、Sitting still for hours 等大学生场景，并用 while / whereas 做对比，落实「理由加场景例证」，论证不空。
重申加升华收束。In conclusion 换词重申 not optional but essential，再用 The sooner we build it, the more ... 升华成呼吁，落实「重申升华呼吁」功能，结尾不烂尾。

items.title: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2022年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: In this task, you are to write an essay on the necessity of developing social skills for college students. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: In today's interconnected campus life, the necessity of developing social skills for college students can hardly be overstated. Far from being an optional extra, the ability to communicate and cooperate is indispensable to a student's growth. To begin with, strong social skills lie at the heart of academic success. Much college learning happens through group projects, seminars and lab work, where students who express ideas clearly and listen to others achieve far more than those who work in isolation. Moreover, these skills pave the way for future careers. Employers today value teamwork and communication as highly as professional knowledge, and graduates who can network and collaborate stand out in interviews. Equally important, good social skills help students build friendships, ease loneliness and adapt to campus life smoothly. Therefore, developing social skills is by no means a trivial matter but a genuine necessity for every college student. Universities and students alike should treat it as seriously as academic study, so that young people can thrive both on campus and beyond.
keyPoints: 背景加立场落地。本段落实了『背景一句引出立场』：先用 In today's interconnected campus life 一句背景铺垫，再用 can hardly be overstated 和 Far from being an optional extra... is indispensable 正面亮出立场，扣住 the necessity of developing social skills for college students， 一开篇就完成了『立场』这一功能。

衔接词串起三例。本段落实了『衔接词串三理由』：用 To begin with 引学业维度（group projects, seminars and lab work），Moreover 递进到就业维度（Employers today value teamwork），Equally important 收口个人维度（build friendships, ease loneliness），三条理由各带 校园实例，层层加码而非松散并列。
因果重申带倡议。本段落实了『因果词重申加倡议』：Therefore 把上文收成结论，by no means a trivial matter but a genuine necessity 重申必要性，末句 should treat it as seriously as academic study 补上倡议，逻辑闭环、有落点。

items.title: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose you have taken part in a career planning seminar. Write an account of the seminar and summarize what you have learned from it. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Last week, our university held a career planning seminar in the lecture hall, which attracted a large number of students who are about to face job hunting. The lecture was delivered by an experienced human resources manager, who has helped many graduates find suitable jobs. During the seminar, the speaker focused on how to plan a career and pointed out that many graduates feel lost simply because they have never planned ahead. He suggested that we should first recognize our own interests and strengths, then set clear and realistic goals, and finally start to build up relevant skills as early as possible. What impressed me most was a real story about a student who got an ideal offer through years of careful preparation. This seminar made me realize that career planning should never be put off until graduation. From now on, I will think seriously about what I really want and take small steps toward my goals instead of drifting along. After all, a well-planned future begins with action today.
keyPoints: 背景段一次交代要素。用 "Last week, our university held a career planning seminar...which attracted..." 套用了第一段"时间地点开篇句架"，一句话讲清时间、地点、活动与听众； 再用 "The lecture was delivered by an experienced human resources manager" 引出主讲人，完成 an account of the seminar 的背景交代。
主题句＋三步建议＋最深印象。"the speaker focused on...and pointed out that..." 是概括 主题句，"He suggested that we should first...then...and finally..." 分点列出讲座建议，"What impressed me most was..." 突出印象最深处，既概括又有重点，避免了流水账。

由讲座转出具体收获。"This seminar made me realize that..." 用过渡句把镜头转向自 己，"From now on, I will...instead of..." 落下具体启示，结尾 "a well-planned future begins with action today" 收口，完成 summarize what you have learned from it。

items.title: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose you have read a book recently and intend to recommend it to other members of your book club via an online forum. Briefly introduce the book and explain why it is worth reading. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: I'd like to recommend a book that truly moved me to all of you in our book club. It is Everything I Never Told You, written by Celeste Ng. The novel tells the story of a mixed-race family struggling with expectations, silence and the search for who they really are. There are two reasons why I think it is worth reading. First, what impressed me most is how the book makes you rethink the way we express love and expectations within a family. It taught me that unspoken pressure can hurt the people we care about, instead of simply being an "interesting" story. What's more, the characters' loneliness and quiet struggles feel so real, which makes the novel easy to relate to, and the plain, honest language never gets boring. If you are looking for a book that touches your heart and makes you think, I highly recommend that you give it a read. I'm sure it will stay with you, and I'd love to hear your thoughts on the forum.
keyPoints: 一句点题＋一句概括。落实第 1 段功能：首句 "I'd like to recommend a book that truly moved me" 套用『开篇荐书』句架直接点题；接着 "written by Celeste Ng" 与 "tells the story of a mixed-race family" 给齐书名、作者、内容三要素，完成 Briefly introduce the book，且只一句概括、 不剧透。书名 Everything I Never Told You 以斜体意涵的首字母大写规范呈现。

两理由各配细节。落实第 2 段功能与『分点·理由配细节』方法："First... what impressed me most" 与 "What's more..." 分出两个理由，分别配 "taught me that unspoken pressure can hurt the people we care about" 和 "easy to relate to" 的具体说明，并用 "instead of simply being an "interesting" story" 主动避开空泛夸赞，正面回答 why it is worth reading。

呼吁＋邀交流收尾。落实第 3 段功能："I highly recommend that you give it a read" 用地 道表达发出呼吁，"I'd love to hear your thoughts on the forum" 邀请书友交流，扣回 recommend it to other members of your book club via an online forum 的论坛荐书情境，收束干净。

items.title: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2023年3月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose you have attended a lecture delivered by a famous scholar. Write a report to the campus newspaper, summarizing its most important points. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: A Report on Professor Li's Lecture Last week our university had the honor of hosting a lecture by Professor Li, a well-known scholar in education, who spoke to a full hall of students on how to grow during our college years. The speaker raised several important points. First, he pointed out that lifelong learning is the key to coping with a rapidly changing world, arguing that the knowledge we gain today may soon be out of date. He went on to emphasize that we should turn our curiosity into action and never be afraid of making mistakes, since real growth comes from trying rather than waiting. To illustrate this, he cited his own failures as the most valuable lessons in his career. The lecture was warmly received, and many students felt newly inspired to take charge of their own learning. In short, it offered all of us valuable insight into making the most of our college life.
keyPoints: 导语交代背景。用『Last week our university had the honor of hosting a lecture by Professor Li... who spoke... on how to grow during our college years』一句答全主讲人、场合、主题 三要素，落实导语功能与 a lecture delivered by a famous scholar 的背景交代，凝练不展开。
转述句分点报道。用 First... He went on to emphasize... To illustrate this 把两个核心观点 条理化串联，且全用 he pointed out / emphasized 等转述句，凸显是学者所讲，直接兑现 summarizing its most important points。
一句收束点意义。用『The lecture was warmly received... In short, it offered all of us valuable insight』一句点反响、一句升华意义，收束有力且不再赘述新内容。

items.title: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay that begins with the sentence "Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health." You can make comments, cite examples or use your personal experiences to develop your essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health. This view deserves our serious attention, especially when modern life keeps us under constant pressure and quiet mental troubles often go unnoticed. To begin with, ignoring our inner state can cost us dearly. Long-term stress and anxiety lead to sleeplessness and poor concentration, which in turn damage both our bodies and our performance. Take my own experience as an example: before an important exam, I was so anxious that I could not sleep for nights and ended up doing far worse than usual. Only after I talked to my friends and kept a regular routine did my mind settle down and my results recover. This taught me that the mind clearly deserves the same care we give the body. In conclusion, we should value our minds as much as our bodies. Only when individuals pay attention to their feelings and society offers more support can we truly live a healthy and balanced life.
keyPoints: 抄句后接钩子。首句逐字照抄给定句 Today there is a growing awareness that mental well-being needs to be given as much attention as physical health.，紧接一句 This view deserves our serious attention 点题，落实了「抄句后立刻接钩子」，把给定句接成自己的论证起点。

理由加例子。本段照「主题句→理由→例子→小结」展开：To begin with, ignoring our inner state can cost us dearly 是主题句，随后给失眠、注意力下降的理由，再用 Take my own experience as an example 引出考试焦虑亲历，最后 This taught me that... 回扣中心，兑现了「理由加 例子撑满一段」。
重申加呼吁。结尾仅两句：In conclusion, we should value our minds as much as our bodies 重申立场、呼应 as much attention as physical health；Only when... can we 句呼吁个人与社 会共同行动，收得简短利落，未再展开新例。

items.title: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose the student union of your university is organizing an online discussion on interpersonal relationships. You are to write an essay on ways to maintain a warm and friendly relationship with your classmates and on the benefits of such a relationship. You will have 30 minutes f or the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words .
items.reference: A warm and friendly relationship plays an important part in our campus life. Since we spend most of our time with classmates, it is worth thinking about how to maintain such a relationship and what benefits it can bring. There are several practical ways to keep such a relationship close. First, we should communicate sincerely. For example, when a misunderstanding happens, we can simply talk it over honestly instead of staying cold. Besides, it also helps to support each other in study and daily life. When a classmate misses a lecture, sharing our notes and showing respect for different habits can quickly bring us closer. As a result, such a relationship can bring us real benefits. It eases our pressure when courses get hard, pushes us to make progress together, and creates a strong sense of belonging in class. In short, building such warm bonds with our classmates is well worth our effort throughout the precious college years.
keyPoints: 引题并亮双任务。首段用 plays an important part 落实『陈述重要性』句架，再用 how to maintain such a relationship and what benefits it can bring 把题目的『做法＋好处』两个任务一并 引出，开门见山、方向明确，达成了 outline 第一段『引入并亮中心』的功能。
分点举例写做法。主体段用 First / Besides 分出真诚沟通、互助尊重两条做法，并各配一个 场景——talk it over honestly 与 sharing our notes，把抽象的友好写实，落实了『分点＋举例展开』 方法，回应了 ways to maintain a warm and friendly relationship with your classmates。
因果收束写好处。尾段以 As a result 承接前段做法，列出 eases our pressure、make progress together、sense of belonging 三项好处，再用 In short 重申中心，落实『因果收束法』，回 应了 the benefits of such a relationship。

items.title: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2023年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose the student union of your university is organizing an online discussion on college students doing community service. You are to write an essay on its benefits and the service you can provide to the community. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: These days, more and more college students are getting involved in community service. In my view, this is a meaningful practice that benefits both the community and ourselves. Community service brings benefits to both society and the people who offer it. On the one hand, it warms our neighborhood: by visiting lonely elderly people or helping local children with their studies, we deliver real care to those in need. On the other hand, it shapes us as individuals, since serving others trains our communication skills and sense of responsibility. As for me, the service I can provide is teaching English. Being good at this subject, I plan to offer free English lessons to children in my community every weekend, so that they can enjoy learning and grow with confidence. In short, doing community service is well worth our effort, as it helps others and improves ourselves at the same time. I sincerely hope that more of us will step out and act.
keyPoints: 一句引题＋一句表态。落实首段蓝图：第一句 These days, more and more college students are getting involved in community service 引出话题；第二句 In my view, this is a meaningful practice that benefits both the community and ourselves 直接亮立场并预告『利人利 己』两条线，对应 its benefits。

主题句＋两层好处＋落地服务。用主题句 Community service brings benefits to both society and the people who offer it 统起本段，再以 On the one hand / On the other hand 分出惠 及他人与提升自己两层（各配老人、孩子的小场景），随后用 As for me 转到 the service you can provide to the community，落到每周末免费教孩子英语这件具体可行的事。
重申＋号召闭环。用 In short 重申『利人利己』立场，再用 I sincerely hope that more of us will step out and act 发出号召，呼应学生会的 online discussion，结构收口。

items.title: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on a campus event that has impressed them most. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Among all the campus events I have taken part in, a volunteer teaching trip impressed me the most. It was last autumn that I joined our university volunteer team and traveled to a small rural primary school. I still remember the moment when I walked into that simple classroom and began my first English lesson. The children sat straight, their eyes shining with curiosity, and they repeated every new word after me as loudly as they could. When the bell rang, instead of running out to play, they crowded around my desk, asking how to pronounce the words on their notebooks. At that moment, I felt truly needed for the first time, and a warm sense of responsibility rose in my heart. This experience taught me that knowledge is not only something for exams, but also a light that can warm and guide others. That is exactly why this volunteer trip remains the campus event that touches me most.
keyPoints: 点题表态到位。首句 Among all the campus events... impressed me the most 直接套用首 段『点题开篇』句架，一句锁定 a campus event that has impressed them most；第二句用 It was last autumn that... 交代时间地点，开门见山不空转。
细节加感受成画面。用 their eyes shining、repeated every new word、crowded around my desk 三个感官细节铺出画面，结尾 I felt truly needed for the first time 落到情感，正是『感官细 节铺场景』方法的落地，避免了流水账。
升华并回扣。This experience taught me that... 把经历提升为对知识价值的认识，末句 remains the campus event that touches me most 回扣 a campus event that has impressed them most，首尾闭环。

items.title: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on the recent development in their hometown.You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Over the past few years, my hometown has undergone remarkable changes. As a student writing for our university newspaper, I would like to share two of them that have impressed me the most: transportation and the environment. In the past, it used to take us hours of bumpy driving to reach the provincial capital. Now, however, a new high-speed railway gets us there in just two hours, and the widened roads have made daily travel far more convenient. Another change worth mentioning is the environment. The small river that once smelled terrible has been cleaned up, and several green parks have been built along its banks, where families now enjoy walking after dinner. All these changes have made my hometown a much better place to live in. As someone who grew up there, I feel truly proud, and I firmly believe that it will become even more beautiful and livable in the years to come.
keyPoints: 总述＋点明投稿身份并预告两点。开头用 Over the past few years, my hometown has undergone remarkable changes 亮出总变化，落实了「亮明总变化」句架；再用 share two of them ... transportation and the environment 预告分点，同时 writing for our university newspaper 点明 投稿身份，扣住 the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students 的场景。

两组过去→如今→好处的对比。交通用 In the past, it used to ... / Now, however ... 的对比 句架写出高铁与拓路；环境用 Another change worth mentioning is the environment 自然过渡，再 以 once smelled terrible 对 has been cleaned up 形成对比，families now enjoy walking after dinner 给出具体画面，落实了「对比展开」方法。

总评收拢＋自豪展望。用 All these changes have made my hometown a much better place to live in 把两点收拢，再以 I feel truly proud 与 I firmly believe that it will become even more beautiful and livable 抒发自豪并展望，落实「收尾＝总评感受＋展望」，给校报读者一个情感 落点。

items.title: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2023年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on what in their university impresses them most.You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Among the many things on campus, it is the university library that has impressed me most. While my college offers modern labs and lively clubs, none of them stays in my heart as deeply as that quiet building. Quiet and well-lit, the library offers a space where I can truly focus and lose myself in books. Surrounded by towering shelves, I felt the joy of learning for the very first time. What touched me even more was a small experience. I still remember the day when I was searching desperately for an out-of-print book. It was a gentle old librarian who spent half an hour helping me track it down, which made me realize that this place is warmed not only by knowledge but also by kindness. Looking back, the library is more than a study room; it has taught me to seek knowledge actively rather than passively. That is why this quiet corner will always be the most unforgettable part of my university life.
keyPoints: 由泛收缩、一句亮主角。首段用 Among the many things on campus, it is the university library that has impressed me most 由校园万物收缩到图书馆一个对象并亮明态度，正面回应 what in their university impresses them most；再用 none of them stays in my heart as deeply 把『最』 写实。

氛围＋经历双层落实。主体段先用 Quiet and well-lit, the library offers a space 写氛围， 再用 I still remember the day when 引出找绝版书受馆员相助的经历，并以强调句＋定语从句 It was a gentle old librarian who ... which made me realize 升级表达，把它为何 impresses them most 写到 可感。
升华＋首尾呼应。结尾用 the library is more than a study room; it has taught me 由事及 己升华，再以 That is why this quiet corner will always be the most unforgettable part 回扣开头、 定格『最』。

items.title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university is seeking students’ opinions on whether university libraries should be open to the public. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Whether university libraries should open their doors to the public has sparked heated debate in recent years. In my view, these libraries should indeed be accessible to ordinary citizens, provided that reasonable management measures are in place. Two reasons support my position. Firstly, opening university libraries promotes the sharing of knowledge. Many valuable books and academic resources sit idle on the shelves, and allowing the public to use them turns campus libraries into vibrant centers of lifelong learning. Moreover, such openness enriches the cultural life of the whole community. For instance, a retired worker or a curious teenager could freely explore fields they never studied at school, which narrows the gap between universities and society. Admittedly, outside visitors may strain limited seats and disturb students. Yet this problem can be eased by setting fixed visiting hours and registration rules. Therefore, I firmly believe university libraries should welcome the public, so long as students' study needs are fully protected.
keyPoints: 引争议+表态一步到位。本段落实「开门见山亮立场」：第一句 Whether ... has sparked heated debate 抛出争议话题，第二句 In my view ... provided that ... 立即表态并加上「合理管理」前 提，既兑现 express your view 的选边要求，又为尾段让步埋线。
两理由各按点理例收。本段兑现「点—理—例—收」：Firstly 领出知识共享这一分论点，用 「藏书闲置→盘活」给出后果；Moreover 递进到公共文化，用「退休工人/好奇少年」这个具体例子落 地，最后 which narrows the gap 一句把话题收回中心，避免空喊口号。
先让步再驳回收尾。本段落实「让步后重申」：Admittedly 承认挤占座位的顾虑，Yet 转折 给出限时与登记的解决办法，Therefore 重申立场并用 so long as 补上折中条件，呼应首段的「有条件 开放」。

items.title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university is seeking students’ opinions on whether university sports facilities should be open to the public. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: In my view, university sports facilities should be opened to the public rather than kept behind closed gates. In the following paragraphs I will give my reasons. To begin with, these facilities are usually built with public funding, yet they stand empty on weekends and holidays. Opening them turns a wasted resource into a shared benefit for taxpayers. What is more, many communities lack affordable places to exercise, so free access to a campus track or gym would clearly improve residents' health. Admittedly, some people worry about campus safety and extra costs. Nevertheless, these problems can be eased by fixed opening hours, an entry registration and a small fee. To sum up, I firmly believe that universities should open their sports facilities to the public. It is advisable that they first set up proper management, so that both students and residents can enjoy the resource in harmony.
keyPoints: 开门亮立场落地。首段用 In my view ... should be opened to the public rather than kept behind closed gates 一句直接选边，再用 In the following paragraphs I will give my reasons 预告下 文，正是『开门亮立场』方法的落地。
两理由＋让步成段。本段用 To begin with 给公共资源理由、What is more 给社区健康理 由，各配一句解释，再用 Admittedly ... Nevertheless ... 回应安全与成本顾虑，兑现了『分层给理由并 回应顾虑』。
重申加建议收束。结尾 To sum up, I firmly believe ... 重申立场与首段呼应，It is advisable that they first set up proper management 补一句建议收尾，完成『重申立场配建议』。

items.title: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2024年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university is seeking students’ opinions on whether university canteens should be open to the public. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Recently, our university has been collecting opinions on whether campus canteens should welcome outside visitors. In my view, opening them to the public is a wise move that benefits both the campus and the community. For one thing, university canteens usually offer clean and affordable meals, so opening them can relieve the dining pressure faced by nearby residents and office workers who struggle to find cheap lunches. For another, the extra income earned from these visitors allows canteens to upgrade their equipment and even lower prices for students. Admittedly, more diners may cause crowding and raise safety concerns; however, such problems can be eased by setting fixed visiting hours and checking visitors at the gate. Therefore, I firmly believe that a properly managed open canteen is worthwhile. As long as student needs come first, sharing this resource makes our university a warmer part of society.
keyPoints: 开门见山表态。首段用 In my view, opening them to the public is a wise move 一句直接 亮牌，落实了『点题句加表态句』方法，开头即满足 express your view。
两理由加让步。段内 For one thing… For another… 摆出便民、增收两条理由，并落到 nearby residents、lower prices for students 等具体场景，再用 Admittedly…however… 让步回应拥 挤与安全，论证有据。
重申并升华。结尾 Therefore, I firmly believe… 重申立场，末句 As long as student needs come first 把话题拔高到共享意义，与开头呼应形成闭环。

items.title: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose the business school of your university is conducting a survey to collect students' opinions on the express delivery service industry in China. You are to write a response about its recent development and its impact on people's lives. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: As a student invited to share my views in this survey, I am glad to comment on the express delivery industry in China, which has grown at an astonishing pace in recent years. To begin with, the recent development of this industry is remarkable. Delivery networks now reach even remote villages, and parcels that once took a week can be delivered overnight. Smart lockers and automated sorting centres, powered by big data, have made the whole process faster and more accurate than ever before. More importantly, this development has reshaped our daily lives. With reliable next-day delivery, people can shop online for almost anything, from food to books, without leaving home. Such convenience saves us time and energy, and it has also created millions of jobs for delivery workers across the country. In conclusion, China's express delivery industry has advanced rapidly and brought real benefits to ordinary people. I firmly believe it will continue to make our lives even more convenient.
keyPoints: 开头即应景亮中心。本段用 As a student invited to share my views in this survey 呼应调 查情境、点明应答身份，再以 which has grown at an astonishing pace 的定语从句总起中心，落实了 首段『应邀点题加亮中心』的功能。
发展段有具体支撑。本段用 parcels that once took a week can be delivered overnight 做 今昔对比，又举 Smart lockers and automated sorting centres 的智能技术，把『发展』写得具体可 信，而非空喊『很发达』。
影响落到普通人。本段以 More importantly 递进到影响，用 people can shop online for almost anything 写个人便利，再以 created millions of jobs 补社会层面的就业影响，从个人到社会有 层次。
总评加展望收尾。本段用 In conclusion 合并发展与影响重申中心，再以 I firmly believe it will continue 表态展望收尾，干净呼应开头。

items.title: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on how to enrich students' knowledge of traditional Chinese culture. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: Traditional Chinese culture is a treasure that shapes our national identity, yet many students today know little about it. As a contributor to our university newspaper, I would like to share several practical ways to enrich students' understanding of this precious heritage. To begin with, our university could offer optional courses and regular lectures on classical literature, calligraphy and traditional festivals, so as to build a solid foundation of knowledge. In addition, hands-on activities are equally important. By organizing cultural experiences such as paper-cutting workshops or tea ceremonies, students can feel the charm of tradition rather than merely reading about it. Moreover, we can make full use of new media, posting short videos and articles online to spread cultural knowledge in a way that appeals to young people. In conclusion, combining formal learning, personal experience and modern technology would help students appreciate traditional Chinese culture far more deeply. I sincerely hope these suggestions will benefit us all.
keyPoints: 两句扣题亮中心。落实『扣征稿点主题』：首句用『___ is a treasure ... yet ...』点出意义， 第二句以投稿人身份『As a contributor to our university newspaper, I would like to share several practical ways』亮出中心，两句内就回扣 how to enrich students' knowledge of traditional Chinese culture，不绕圈。

三办法各带理由。落实『一条办法一句理由』：To begin with 领起选修课并用『so as to build a solid foundation』给理由；In addition 领起体验活动并用『students can feel the charm of tradition rather than merely reading about it』说明好处；Moreover 领起新媒体。三条办法都具体到 剪纸、茶艺、短视频，避免空喊。
归总呼应结尾。落实『归总加呼吁』：In conclusion 把 formal learning, personal experience and modern technology 三条收成一句，重申价值，末句『I sincerely hope these suggestions will benefit us all』面向读者呼吁，首尾呼应、结构完整。

items.title: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2024年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on how the students can contribute to a green campus. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: A green campus is no longer a slogan but a shared responsibility, and students play a key role in making it real. As members of the campus, we can turn small daily habits into real changes. There are several practical things we can do. First, we should sort our rubbish and recycle paper, bottles and cans, which cuts waste and saves resources. Second, saving water and switching off lights and computers when they are not in use can greatly reduce the energy our campus consumes. Moreover, choosing to walk, cycle or share bikes for short trips lowers carbon emissions, and passing used textbooks on to younger students gives them a second life instead of being thrown away. In short, a green campus grows out of these everyday actions rather than empty talk. If every student takes one small step, our campus will surely become cleaner, greener and more livable for us all.
keyPoints: 两句总起点题。本段落实第一段「总起点题」的功能：用 "A green campus is no longer a slogan but a shared responsibility" 一句拔高意义，再用 "we can turn small daily habits into real changes" 引出学生能做的事，正好套用了『点明意义』与『引出话题』两条句架。
分点加效果的主体。本段落实「分述具体做法」：先 "There are several practical things we can do" 总起，再用 First / Second / Moreover 领出垃圾分类、节水节电、绿色出行与二手书三条做 法，每条都跟一句效果如 "which cuts waste and saves resources"，做到动作配效果、不空洞。
收束加号召。本段落实「总结呼吁升华」："In short, a green campus grows out of these everyday actions rather than empty talk" 回扣开头的行动主题，末句 "If every student takes one small step" 用条件句发出号召并给出更宜居的前景。

items.title: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university is seeking students' opinions on the necessity of making College Chinese a compulsory course. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: The question of whether College Chinese should be a compulsory course has sparked heated discussion on campus. In my view, making it compulsory is both necessary and wise. Admittedly, some students argue that Chinese is their mother tongue and needs no further study. Yet this view overlooks two facts. First, a solid command of Chinese sharpens our thinking and expression. Many science majors write reports full of grammatical errors and muddled logic, which weakens their careers. A required course would help them communicate clearly. What's more, classical Chinese carries our cultural heritage. Through reading poems and essays, students inherit values and a sense of identity that no other subject offers. Therefore, I firmly believe College Chinese deserves a place as a compulsory course. It is not a burden but an investment in both our language ability and our cultural roots.
keyPoints: 一句背景一句立场。首段落实了『首段：一句背景一句立场』：第一句 The question of whether College Chinese should be a compulsory course has sparked heated discussion 用套架点 出争议背景；第二句 In my view, making it compulsory is both necessary and wise 立刻亮明赞成立 场，开头就让阅卷人看清你选哪边。

让步—观点—例证—小结落地。主体段先用 Admittedly, some students argue... Yet this view overlooks 让步再反驳；再用 First 与 What's more 分领两条理由；每条都配例子——理工科学生 write reports full of grammatical errors and muddled logic、classical Chinese carries our cultural heritage，做到了不空喊口号。
连接词重申再升华。尾段用 Therefore 领起，Therefore, I firmly believe College Chinese deserves a place 换句重申立场；末句 It is not a burden but an investment 用『不是A而是B』把意义 拔高，首尾呼应、没有引入新理由。

items.title: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university is conducting a survey to collect students' opinions on the appropriate use of AI technology in assisting learning. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes for the task. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: In my view, AI technology, when used appropriately, is a valuable ally in learning rather than a shortcut that replaces genuine effort. Since our university is surveying students on this issue, I would like to voice my support for embracing AI in a sensible, balanced way. There are solid reasons for this position. First, AI tools raise learning efficiency: a chatbot can explain a confusing grammar point instantly, check my essay for mistakes, or gather background material that once took hours in the library. Second, AI offers personalized tutoring, adjusting its explanations to my own pace and weak spots. Admittedly, however, over-reliance is a real danger; if students let AI think for them, their own analytical skills will gradually wither. Therefore, the key lies in "appropriate" use. We should treat AI as an assistant that guides and inspires, not a machine that hands us ready-made answers. Used within this boundary, AI can truly make learning smarter.
keyPoints: 两句完成表态与扣题。首句 In my view... rather than a shortcut 用「亮明观点」句架一句 站队，第二句 Since our university is surveying students... 用「回应语境」句架接住调查背景，落实了 表态段「亮立场＋点价值」的功能。
分点举例加让步显辩证。There are solid reasons 领起后，First / Second 切出效率与个性 化两条理由，explain... check... or gather 用「举例落地」把好处具象化；Admittedly, however, over- reliance is a real danger 用「让步转折」补上风险，正扣 appropriate 的边界感。
回扣题眼并划边界收口。Therefore, the key lies in "appropriate" use 用「回扣题眼」把落 点钉回核心词，an assistant... not a machine 给出具体边界，末句 Used within this boundary... 升华 作结，与开头立场首尾呼应。

items.title: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university is organizing a forum on the development of students' cross-cultural communication abilities. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: In an era of deepening globalization, the ability to communicate across cultures has become indispensable. I firmly believe that universities should attach great importance to developing students' cross-cultural communication abilities. For one thing, such competence helps reduce misunderstandings rooted in different customs and values, making cooperation smoother. For instance, when I joined an international online project, teammates from three countries reached agreement quickly only because we respected each other's communication styles. For another, in today's competitive job market, graduates who can embrace diversity and work with global partners clearly stand out. Therefore, we students should seize every chance to broaden our horizons, such as joining exchange programs, reading foreign works, or making friends with international students. Only by becoming true global citizens can we thrive in a connected world.
keyPoints: 背景加立场一步到位。首段两句落实了『背景引出观点』：第一句 In an era of deepening globalization... has become indispensable 用背景句引题，第二句 I firmly believe that universities should attach great importance... 直接亮立场，开门见山、切题明确。
点理例结撑实主体。主体段用 For one thing / For another 串起两条理由，第一条后接 For instance, when I joined an international online project... 这个大学生亲历小例把道理坐实，正是『点 —理—例—结』的落地，避免了空喊口号。
行动加倒装收束。结尾用 Therefore, we students should seize every chance... 把论证收成 具体做法，再用倒装句 Only by becoming true global citizens can we thrive... 升华，呼应立场又不重 复原话。

items.title: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose the student union of your university is collecting opinions on improving its work for the coming year. You are now to write a response by suggesting how it can better enrich student life. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: I am truly glad that the student union is collecting our opinions for the coming year, and I would like to share a few thoughts on how campus life could become richer and more colourful. To begin with, I suggest that more student clubs be set up, ranging from photography to debating, so that everyone can find a hobby and make new friends. It would also be helpful if the union organized regular sports meets and art festivals, because such events relax us after study and build a stronger sense of community. Another idea is to invite experts to hold lectures and workshops, which would broaden our horizons and prepare us for future careers. I believe these suggestions, if adopted, will make our daily life on campus far more enjoyable. Thank you for listening, and I am always ready to offer any help the union may need.
keyPoints: 开门见山扣焦点。开头用『I am truly glad that the student union is collecting our opinions』回应征询，再用『share a few thoughts on how campus life could become richer』亮出 立场，一句话落实了第一段『回应征询并表态』的功能。

三条建议各带理由。三句都走『建议+理由』：『I suggest that more student clubs be set up ... so that everyone can find a hobby』『It would also be helpful if ... because such events relax us』『Another idea is to invite experts ... which would broaden our horizons』，用 To begin with / also / Another idea 分隔，落实分点给建议的功能。
回扣中心表支持。『I believe these suggestions, if adopted, will make our daily life on campus far more enjoyable』回扣丰富生活的中心，末句『I am always ready to offer any help』积 极表态收尾，无称呼落款。

items.title: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose it is proposed that all university students should be required to learn academic writing. You are now to write a response by stating what you think of the proposal. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: It has recently been proposed that all university students should be required to learn academic writing. In my view, this proposal deserves our full support, for such a skill is far more than an optional refinement. For one thing, academic writing trains students to organize ideas logically and cite sources honestly. When I wrote my first term paper, I struggled to structure arguments and nearly copied online material by mistake; a writing course would have taught me both clear reasoning and academic integrity. For another, this ability pays off well beyond campus. Whether a graduate applies for a research position or drafts a report at work, the capacity to express thoughts precisely on paper often determines success. Admittedly, mastering academic writing takes time and effort. Nevertheless, the long-term rewards clearly outweigh the cost. Therefore, I strongly believe universities should make this course compulsory, ideally starting from the first year so that students benefit throughout their studies.
keyPoints: 复述加表态。首段落实『复述加表态开篇』：It has recently been proposed that... 用同义 改写复述提案、点题；紧接 In my view, this proposal deserves our full support 一句亮明支持立场， 兑现 stating what you think of the proposal，开篇即拿任务分。
分点加例证。第二段落实『分点理由配例证』：For one thing... for another... 两条理由并 列；中间 When I wrote my first term paper... 用亲身场景把『论文规范与学术诚信』坐实，Whether a graduate... 把价值延伸到就业深造，两条都咬住学术写作本身，不空谈。
让步加重申。第三段落实『让步转折收尾』：Admittedly... 先认成本，Nevertheless... 转折 抬高回报，Therefore, I strongly believe... 顺势重申应必修并补『从大一开设』的温和建议，立场首尾 一致、毫不摇摆。

items.title: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2025年12月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university is organizing a forum on how students can make the best use of on- campus resources for academic development. You are now to write an essay to express your view. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference: On-campus resources are a treasure that too many students overlook. In my view, actively making use of these facilities is one of the smartest ways to boost our academic development. There are several practical steps we can take. First, we should visit the library and its online databases regularly, since they offer academic papers and books that turn a rough idea into a well-supported argument. Moreover, we ought to consult professors during their office hours, because a ten-minute talk often clears up confusion that hours of self-study cannot. In addition, attending academic lectures and joining study groups exposes us to fresh perspectives and keeps our motivation high. In short, the campus is full of tools waiting to be used. Only by taking the initiative to utilize them can we truly grow as learners and get the most out of our university years.
keyPoints: 首段两句立观点。本段用『点题引入＋亮明观点』句架：一句 On-campus resources are a treasure that too many students overlook 把话题立起来，一句 In my view 抛出总观点，落实了 outline 第一段『点价值亮总观点』的功能。
主体段并列三做法。本段以 There are several practical steps 领起，用 First / Moreover / In addition 串起图书馆数据库、请教教授、听讲座三条做法，每条都跟一句 since/because 理由，落实 『分点给具体做法』。
结尾重申并升华。本段用 In short 收束、Only by ... can we ... 强调句升华，重申主动利用资 源方能成长，落实『重申升华呼应主题』。

items.title: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第1套）
items.prompt: Suppose it is proposed that university students should be required to participate in at least one research project. You are now to write a response by stating what you think of the proposal in terms of its necessity and practicality. You will have 30 minutes to write the response. You should write at least 120 words but not more than 180 words.
items.reference: Requiring university students to take part in at least one research project is a proposal worth supporting, provided it is implemented flexibly and students can choose topics that interest them. From my perspective, such a policy is both necessary and practical for most undergraduates. First, it is necessary because research experience bridges the gap between textbook knowledge and real-world problem solving. Through a well-designed project, students learn to ask meaningful questions, collect reliable data, and think critically. These abilities are essential for their future careers. Second, it is practical because universities already have laboratories, supervisors, and course projects in place. A single semester-long project can fit into the existing curriculum without placing too much burden on students. Therefore, I support the proposal. It helps students develop practical skills that lectures alone cannot provide, and its flexible design makes it achievable for most universities.
keyPoints: 同义转述+明确立场。首句用 Requiring university students to take part in... 转述了提案内 容，避免机械照抄；第二句用 both necessary and practical 直接点出两个论证维度。
分论点+例子支撑。用 First/Second 分别对应必要性与可行性，每个论点都给出具体理由 （bridges the gap / universities already have...in place），并加入 well-designed project 等具体 场景。
重申立场并收束。用 Therefore 回扣开头立场，用 practical skills that lectures alone cannot provide 总结双重价值，避免提出新观点。

items.title: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
items.prompt: Suppose your university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coming edition on future applications of robots on campus. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but not more than 180 words.
items.reference: Robots are no longer figures from science fiction; in the near future, they are likely to become common helpers on university campuses. As the university newspaper invites students to imagine future applications of robots on campus, I believe intelligent machines will mainly reshape our campus life in three areas: library services, laboratory assistance, and daily guidance. First, in the library, robots could locate, fetch, and even deliver requested books to reading rooms, saving students valuable study time. Second, in science labs, robotic assistants might handle repetitive experiments or dangerous chemicals, allowing students to focus on analysis and innovation. Third, robots placed around the campus could provide real-time directions and campus information for visitors and freshmen, reducing confusion during busy periods. Of course, these technologies should serve people rather than replace human interaction. If universities introduce robots wisely, campus life will become more efficient, safe, and welcoming.
keyPoints: 引入趋势并亮中心。首句用 Robots are no longer figures from science fiction 引入趋势， 第二句回扣题目中的 future applications of robots on campus，第三句用 I believe ... will mainly reshape ... in three areas 给出中心论点并预告三个分论点，落实了“引入+中心句”方法。

三点论证支撑中心。用 First/Second/Third 衔接图书馆、实验室、校园导览三个场景；每个 场景都说明机器人具体做什么（locate, fetch, deliver / handle repetitive experiments / provide real- time directions），并点出价值（saving time / allowing focus / reducing confusion），对应“主题句 +举例+价值句”的展开法。
限定态度并收束。先用 Of course 做限定，指出机器人应 serve people rather than replace human interaction，再用 If universities introduce robots wisely 给出条件性展望，避免结论空洞，落 实了“让步/限定+总结+展望”方法。

items.title: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.paperTitle: 2026年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
items.prompt: Suppose you are invited to put forward a proposal to the university on how to make students' campus life easier. You are now to write an essay to make your proposal. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but not more than 180 words.
items.reference: I am honored to submit a proposal on how to make students' campus life easier. As daily routines grow more demanding, small improvements in campus services can save students considerable time and energy. First, the university could develop a one-stop mobile app that integrates course schedules, room bookings, and exam arrangements. This would spare students the trouble of switching between multiple platforms. Second, extending library opening hours and adding more self-study spaces during examination periods would reduce overcrowding. Third, improving shuttle-bus frequency between teaching buildings and dormitories would make commuting less stressful. These practical measures, if implemented, would significantly ease students' daily pressures. I sincerely hope the university will consider this proposal and take steps toward a more convenient campus life.
keyPoints: 落实首段功能：点明身份、目的与背景。首句 I am honored to submit a proposal on... 直 接回应 put forward a proposal to the university on how to make students' campus life easier，点 明受邀者身份与提案主题；第二句用 Small improvements... can save... 为背景铺垫，避免开头冗长。
主体段三条建议均具体可操作。First... Second... Third... 分别给出APP整合、学习空间、校园 交通三项措施，每项都紧跟一句理由，扣住 easier 这一核心。
结尾总结并礼貌呼吁。These practical measures, if implemented... 总结价值，I sincerely hope... 礼貌呼吁学校考虑，未引入新内容，收束自然。

items.title: The Value of Failure
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the value of failure. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
Nobody likes failure, yet almost everyone has to face it. In my view, failure is not the opposite of success but a necessary step towards it.

First, failure teaches us lessons that success rarely offers. When everything goes smoothly, we seldom ask why; when a plan collapses, we are forced to examine our weaknesses and change our methods. A student who fails an exam may discover that memorising facts is not enough, and that lesson will serve him far better than a lucky pass. Second, failure builds resilience. People who have recovered from setbacks are usually calmer when the next difficulty arrives, because they know from experience that a bad moment does not mean a bad life.

Of course, failure is valuable only when we reflect on it. Those who blame others or give up learn nothing. If we treat every setback as a chance to improve, failure becomes a teacher rather than a wall.
keyPoints: 首段明确观点：失败是通往成功的必经一步。
两个分论点分别是“失败带来教训”和“失败培养韧性”，用 First / Second 标示。
举例要具体而简短，避免泛泛而谈。
结尾强调反思，使论证完整。

items.title: More Families Raising Pets
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the chart below, which shows that the proportion of Chinese families keeping pets has risen steadily over the past decade. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
The chart clearly shows a steady rise in the proportion of Chinese families that keep pets over the past decade. Several reasons may explain this trend.

To begin with, living standards have improved, so more families can afford the food, medical care and toys that a pet needs. Secondly, many young people live alone in big cities. A cat or a dog brings warmth to an empty flat and gives them a reason to go out and meet other owners. Thirdly, public attitudes have changed: pets are now widely seen as members of the family rather than mere animals.

This trend has visible effects. The pet industry is growing quickly, creating jobs in shops, clinics and online services. At the same time, owning a pet is a long-term duty. Owners should think carefully before buying an animal and should never abandon it when it becomes inconvenient. In short, the rising number of pets reflects a warmer and wealthier society, but it also calls for greater responsibility.
keyPoints: 第一段概括图表趋势，不逐一罗列数字。
第二段用 To begin with / Secondly / Thirdly 分析原因。
第三段谈影响并提醒养宠物的责任。
描述趋势使用 rise steadily、upward trend 等表达。

items.title: A Journey of a Thousand Miles
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the saying 'A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step.' You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
The saying 'A journey of a thousand miles begins with a single step' tells us that great goals are reached through small beginnings. However ambitious a plan is, it remains a dream until someone takes the first step.

This truth applies to almost everything we do. A student who wants to master English cannot learn thousands of words overnight; he becomes fluent by reading a few pages and practising a short dialogue every day. A person who hopes to run a marathon starts with a slow walk around the block. In both cases, the first step is unimpressive, yet without it nothing else follows. The hardest part is often not the distance but the decision to begin.

Of course, starting alone is not enough; steady effort must follow. Still, the message of the saying remains encouraging: instead of waiting for perfect conditions, we should simply take one small step today, and then another. Progress, however slow, is how every long journey is completed.
keyPoints: 开头点明谚语含义，并亮出中心论点。
用学英语、跑马拉松两个例子具体化“第一步”。
引用谚语时保持原句措辞，注意引号与句号位置。
结尾呼应开头，提出可操作的建议。

items.title: Part-time Jobs for College Students
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on whether college students should take part-time jobs. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
Opinions differ on whether college students should take part-time jobs. In my view, the answer depends on the job and the hours it takes.

On the positive side, a part-time job offers experience that a classroom cannot provide. Working in a shop or a small company, students learn how to talk to customers, follow rules and deal with unexpected problems. They also learn how hard it is to earn money, which makes them spend more wisely.

However, there are risks. If a student works too many hours, study and rest will suffer, and a tired student learns little in class. Some jobs, such as delivering parcels at night, are poorly paid and teach little.

In my view, balance matters most. A student should choose a job related to his interests, work limited hours and never let wages replace learning. Used wisely, a part-time job is a valuable addition to college life.
keyPoints: 首段提出观点：关键在选什么工作、投入多少时间。
正面论述从获得经验和理解赚钱不易两方面展开。
同时承认风险，体现辩证思考。
结尾给出具体建议：与兴趣相关、限定时长。

items.title: How People Spend Their Leisure Time
items.prompt: Directions: For this part, you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the pie chart below, which shows how urban residents spend their leisure time. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
items.reference:
The pie chart shows how urban residents in China spend their spare time. Watching short videos and playing games take the largest share, followed by sports, while reading and other activities account for a smaller part.

This distribution is easy to understand. Short videos and games are cheap, convenient and immediately entertaining: a tired office worker can relax with a phone for ten minutes without leaving his seat. Sports require equipment, time and energy, so they attract fewer people, though the number is growing as health becomes a bigger concern.
